# Overview

**What this is.** The complete Study 3 analysis, written from the Study 3 preregistration as posted on OSF (`Docs/Preregistration/Study3_Preregistration_FINAL.md`), before any Study 3 data exist. In `data_mode = "mock"` it runs on **synthetic** data from `study3_mock_generator.R`: Pavlovia session records with the v0.3 staging build's column names, built from Study 1-2 numeric item responses (re-randomised to the four Study 3 cells) with **known planted effects** (`effects = "planted"`) or with every persona effect set to zero (`effects = "null"`). No participant text is used; all chat and open-ended text is placeholder text, and no text field is printed.

**How the code is organised.** Each section cites the revision-3 section it implements. Every registered decision rule is written once as a small function (section 0.2) and checked on constructed inputs (section 0.3), so each outcome label that revision 3 names (§8.14) can be produced, including outcomes these two synthetic runs do not reach. Where revision 3 does not determine a computation, the notebook makes a choice, says so in place, and logs it with `amb()`; the log, printed at the end and written to `mock_outputs/`, contains only items that revision 3 still leaves open. Changes from the revision-2 notebook are listed in `CHANGES_rev3.md`. When the real data arrive, set `data_mode = "real"` and point `raw_dir`, `tone_file` and the NLP files at them; no analysis code changes.

## 0.1 Helper functions (Prereg §7.1 conventions)

```{r helpers}
# HC3 inference for one coefficient (sandwich::vcovHC type HC3; t on the residual df, as lmtest::coeftest)
hc3 <- function(fit, term, level = .95) {
  V <- sandwich::vcovHC(fit, type = "HC3")
  b <- unname(coef(fit)[term]); se <- sqrt(V[term, term]); df <- df.residual(fit)
  q <- qt(1 - (1 - level) / 2, df)
  tibble(term = term, b = b, se = se, lo = b - q * se, hi = b + q * se, t = b / se, df = df,
         p = 2 * pt(-abs(b / se), df), n = nobs(fit))
}
# §7.1 / §11.1: experiment_version enters the core model as a fixed covariate only if sessions ran under > 1 version
vers_cov <- function(d) if ("experiment_version" %in% names(d) && n_distinct(d$experiment_version, na.rm = TRUE) > 1) "experiment_version" else NULL
# Core model §7.1: lm(Y ~ A * E), A and E coded -0.5 / +0.5
core <- function(d, y, extra = NULL) lm(reformulate(c("A", "E", "A:E", extra), y), data = d)
# Hedges's g on the marginal groups (high - low), pooled across the other factor (§7.1)
g_marg <- function(d, y, f, ci = .95) {
  k <- !is.na(d[[y]]) & !is.na(d[[f]])
  e <- effectsize::hedges_g(d[[y]][k & d[[f]] > 0], d[[y]][k & d[[f]] < 0], ci = ci)
  tibble(g = e$Hedges_g, g_lo = e$CI_low, g_hi = e$CI_high)
}
# Fast Hedges's g (same formula as effectsize::hedges_g: pooled SD, exact small-sample correction) for bootstraps
g_fast <- function(x1, x0) {
  x1 <- x1[!is.na(x1)]; x0 <- x0[!is.na(x0)]
  n1 <- length(x1); n0 <- length(x0); df <- n1 + n0 - 2
  sp <- sqrt(((n1 - 1) * var(x1) + (n0 - 1) * var(x0)) / df)
  (mean(x1) - mean(x0)) / sp * exp(lgamma(df / 2) - log(sqrt(df / 2)) - lgamma((df - 1) / 2))
}
# Factorial d = b / sqrt(MSE of lm(Y ~ A * E)) (§7.1); CI = HC3 CI of b divided by sigma
fact_d <- function(fit, term) { s <- sigma(fit); h <- hc3(fit, term); tibble(d_fact = h$b / s, d_fact_lo = h$lo / s, d_fact_hi = h$hi / s) }
# Registered Bayes factor (§7.1): lmBF(Y ~ A + E + A:E) / lmBF(Y ~ E + A:E), two-level factors, rscaleFixed = 0.5, 100,000 iterations, seed 42
bf_reg <- function(d, y, f, iter = params$bf_iter) {
  dd <- data.frame(y = d[[y]], Af = factor(d$A), Ef = factor(d$E)); dd <- dd[complete.cases(dd), ]
  set.seed(42)
  full <- lmBF(y ~ Af + Ef + Af:Ef, data = dd, rscaleFixed = 0.5, iterations = iter, progress = FALSE)
  red  <- if (f == "A") lmBF(y ~ Ef + Af:Ef, data = dd, rscaleFixed = 0.5, iterations = iter, progress = FALSE) else
                        lmBF(y ~ Af + Af:Ef, data = dd, rscaleFixed = 0.5, iterations = iter, progress = FALSE)
  exp((full / red)@bayesFactor$bf)
}
# Marginal-group ttestBF (r = 0.707), and the directional BF+0 (nullInterval = c(0, Inf): favours high > low)
bf_marg <- function(d, y, f, directional = FALSE) {
  k <- !is.na(d[[y]]); x1 <- d[[y]][k & d[[f]] > 0]; x0 <- d[[y]][k & d[[f]] < 0]
  set.seed(42)
  b <- ttestBF(x = x1, y = x0, rscale = 0.707, nullInterval = if (directional) c(0, Inf) else NULL)
  exp(b@bayesFactor$bf[1])
}
bf_cat <- function(bf) case_when(is.na(bf) ~ "NA", bf > 100 ~ "Extreme H1", bf > 30 ~ "Very strong H1",
  bf > 10 ~ "Strong H1", bf > 3 ~ "Moderate H1", bf > 1 ~ "Anecdotal H1", bf > 1/3 ~ "Anecdotal H0",
  bf > 1/10 ~ "Moderate H0", bf > 1/30 ~ "Strong H0", TRUE ~ "Very strong H0")
# Welch TOST from summary statistics (TOSTER::tsum_TOST), raw or SMD bounds. p_t = the first test that
# tsum_TOST reports (the two-sided Welch t test of the same contrast; used by the R2a/R2b 'contradicted' rule, §7.2).
tost_welch <- function(x1, x0, bound, type = "raw") {
  x1 <- x1[!is.na(x1)]; x0 <- x0[!is.na(x0)]
  t <- TOSTER::tsum_TOST(m1 = mean(x1), sd1 = sd(x1), n1 = length(x1), m2 = mean(x0), sd2 = sd(x0), n2 = length(x0),
                         low_eqbound = -bound, high_eqbound = bound, eqbound_type = type, alpha = .05, var.equal = FALSE)
  stopifnot(identical(rownames(t$TOST), c("t-test", "TOST Lower", "TOST Upper")))
  es <- t$effsize; sn <- setdiff(rownames(es), "Raw")
  tibble(diff = es["Raw", "estimate"], diff_lo90 = es["Raw", "lower.ci"], diff_hi90 = es["Raw", "upper.ci"],
         gav = es[sn, "estimate"], gav_lo90 = es[sn, "lower.ci"], gav_hi90 = es[sn, "upper.ci"],
         p_t = t$TOST$p.value[1], p_lower = t$TOST$p.value[2], p_upper = t$TOST$p.value[3],
         p_max = max(t$TOST$p.value[2:3]), equivalent = max(t$TOST$p.value[2:3]) < .05, bound = bound, type = type)
}
tost_f <- function(d, y, f, bound, type = "raw") tost_welch(d[[y]][d[[f]] > 0], d[[y]][d[[f]] < 0], bound, type)
# TOST on a regression coefficient (§7.1, §8.8): two one-sided t tests with the HC3 SE and the residual df
tost_coef <- function(fit, term, bound) {
  h <- hc3(fit, term)
  pl <- pt((h$b + bound) / h$se, h$df, lower.tail = FALSE); pu <- pt((h$b - bound) / h$se, h$df)
  tibble(b = h$b, se = h$se, bound = bound, p_lower = pl, p_upper = pu, p_max = max(pl, pu), equivalent = max(pl, pu) < .05)
}
# Joint TOST x Bayes classification (§7.1; registered model-based BF10)
joint_class <- function(equiv, bf10) case_when(
  is.na(bf10) | is.na(equiv) ~ "NA",
  equiv & bf10 < 1/3 ~ "evidence of absence",
  equiv & bf10 >= 1/3 & bf10 < 3 ~ "TOST-only equivalence",
  !equiv & bf10 < 1/3 ~ "Bayesian-only null",
  !equiv & bf10 >= 3 ~ "evidence of presence",
  TRUE ~ "inconclusive")
# within-cell bootstrap indices (§8 intro: resampling participants within cells, 5,000 resamples, percentile CIs)
boot_idx <- function(cell, B = params$n_boot, seed = 42) {
  set.seed(seed); sp <- split(seq_along(cell), cell)
  replicate(B, unlist(lapply(sp, function(i) i[sample.int(length(i), length(i), TRUE)]), use.names = FALSE), simplify = FALSE)
}
ols <- function(X, y) .lm.fit(X, y)$coefficients
q95 <- function(x) quantile(x, c(.025, .975), na.rm = TRUE, names = FALSE)
pooled_within_sd <- function(y, cell) { k <- !is.na(y); r <- y[k] - ave(y[k], cell[k]); sqrt(sum(r^2) / (sum(k) - length(unique(cell[k])))) }
zs <- function(x) as.numeric(scale(x))
paired_ci <- function(x, y, level = .95) { t <- t.test(x, y, paired = TRUE, conf.level = level); d <- x - y
  tibble(diff = mean(d), lo = t$conf.int[1], hi = t$conf.int[2], p = t$p.value, dz = mean(d) / sd(d), n = length(d)) }
kt <- function(x, cap = NULL, digits = 3) knitr::kable(x, caption = cap, digits = digits)
```

## 0.2 Registered decision rules (revision 3)

```{r decision-rules}
BOUND_R2  <- 0.40   # §7.2 R2a/R2b, Change 25: 0.40 x 1.00 (pooled within-group SD of Corporate Liability, Studies 1-2)
BOUND_PSR <- 0.39   # §7.2 H2 step 1(c) and §8.13 O1: 0.40 x 0.975 (pooled within-group SD of PSR, Studies 1-2)
P_G0 <- 0.17; P_T0 <- 0   # §7.2 H2 step 4b: fixed predictions (impression; tone)
# H1 (§7.2): supported / contradicted / not supported
dec_H1 <- function(b, p) if (b > 0 && p < .05) "supported" else if (b < 0 && p < .05) "contradicted" else "not supported"
# R2a / R2b (§7.2, PI decision 10): supported if the raw-bound TOST is significant; contradicted if not and the Welch test p < .05
dec_R2 <- function(tost_p_max, welch_p) if (tost_p_max < .05) "supported" else if (welch_p < .05) "contradicted" else "inconclusive"
lab_R2 <- function(dec, bf10) if (dec == "inconclusive") "not supported (inconclusive)" else if (dec == "contradicted") "contradicted" else
  if (bf10 < 1/3) "evidence of absence" else if (bf10 < 3) "equivalent (TOST-only)" else "equivalent (TOST), Bayes factor favors an effect"
# H2 step 1 (§7.2): the four descriptions, checked in order, with the registered addition
desc_H2 <- function(b, p, tost_eq) {
  d <- if (b > 0 && p < .05) "positive effect detected" else if (b < 0 && p < .05) "negative effect detected" else
       if (tost_eq) "effects as large as the smallest effect of interest excluded" else "not resolved at this N"
  if (p < .05 && tost_eq) paste(d, "and smaller than the smallest effect of interest") else d
}
# H2 steps 4-5 (§7.2): 'closer' only if the CIs of D in steps 4 and 5 agree
cmp_D <- function(lo, hi) if (hi < 0) "impression" else if (lo > 0) "tone" else "neither"
dec_H2_closer <- function(s4, s5) if (s4 == "impression" && s5 == "impression") "the impression version's prediction is closer" else
  if (s4 == "tone" && s5 == "tone") "the tone version's prediction is closer" else "not distinguished"
# H2 step 4b (§7.2, PI decision 13)
lr_4b <- function(bE, se, P0 = P_G0) exp((bE * P0 - P0^2 / 2) / se^2)
dec_4b <- function(lr) if (lr >= 3) "the E effect is closer to the impression version's prediction" else
  if (lr <= 1/3) "the E effect is closer to the tone version's prediction" else "not distinguished"
# H4 (§8.6): lo_PG = 95% CI lower bounds of b(A|P) - b(A|G_halo); lo_GP = lower bounds of b(A|G_halo) - b(A|P)
dec_H4 <- function(S_G, lo_PG, lo_GP) if (S_G >= .50 && all(lo_PG > 0)) "supported" else if (S_G < .50 && any(lo_GP > 0)) "contradicted" else "inconclusive"
# D1 (§8.8): four-way decision with the scale-bound rule (per bound, at probe 1)
dec_D1 <- function(b, p, tost_eq, scale_bound) {
  sig <- p < .05
  lab <- if (tost_eq && sig) (if (b > 0) "first impression, with small growth" else "first impression, with small narrowing") else
         if (sig && b > 0) "accumulation" else if (sig && b < 0) "narrowing" else if (tost_eq) "first impression" else "inconclusive"
  if (scale_bound) lab <- if (sig && b > 0) "accumulation" else if (lab == "inconclusive") lab else "not interpretable: scale bound"
  lab
}
# R2c / R2d (§8.10, PI decision 16): contradicted if any BF10 > 3; supported if none and more than half have BF01 > 3
dec_R2cd <- function(bf10) if (any(bf10 > 3)) "contradicted" else if (sum(1 / bf10 > 3) > length(bf10) / 2) "supported" else "inconclusive"
# R3 (§8.9): contradicted checked first (both conditions cannot hold at N = 272: it would need SE(beta) < .028)
dec_R3 <- function(hi90, lo95, bf_seg) if (lo95 > .20) "contradicted" else if (hi90 < .30 && bf_seg < 1) "supported" else "inconclusive"
# R4 (§8.9, PI decisions 11-12): contradicted if BF10 > 3 or the bonding-composite coefficient >= .25 (checked first; see log)
dec_R4 <- function(bf10, beta_B) if (bf10 > 3 || beta_B >= .25) "contradicted" else if (1 / bf10 > 3) "supported" else "inconclusive"
# R6a (§8.11, PI decision 17)
dec_R6a <- function(lo95, hi95) if (lo95 >= .40) "company-primary" else if (hi95 < .40) "Sylva comparable to the company" else "inconclusive"
# §8.14 label sets for rules that state only a 'supported' outcome, and for checks that state only 'passes'
sup  <- function(x) if (isTRUE(x)) "supported" else "not supported"
pass <- function(x) if (isTRUE(x)) "passes" else "fails"
```

## 0.3 Decision rules checked on constructed inputs

Every outcome label of §7.2, §8.6, §8.8-§8.11 and §8.14 is produced here from constructed statistics, including outcomes that the two synthetic runs do not reach (for example R2a "contradicted", H4 "contradicted", D1 "first impression, with small narrowing").

```{r decision-tests}
stopifnot(
  dec_H1(.3, .01) == "supported", dec_H1(-.3, .01) == "contradicted", dec_H1(.3, .20) == "not supported",
  dec_R2(.01, .60) == "supported", dec_R2(.20, .01) == "contradicted", dec_R2(.20, .30) == "inconclusive",
  lab_R2("supported", .20) == "evidence of absence", lab_R2("supported", 1) == "equivalent (TOST-only)",
  lab_R2("supported", 5) == "equivalent (TOST), Bayes factor favors an effect", lab_R2("inconclusive", 1) == "not supported (inconclusive)",
  desc_H2(.30, .01, FALSE) == "positive effect detected", desc_H2(-.30, .01, FALSE) == "negative effect detected",
  desc_H2(.02, .80, TRUE) == "effects as large as the smallest effect of interest excluded",
  desc_H2(.10, .40, FALSE) == "not resolved at this N",
  desc_H2(.12, .04, TRUE) == "positive effect detected and smaller than the smallest effect of interest",
  desc_H2(-.12, .04, TRUE) == "negative effect detected and smaller than the smallest effect of interest",
  dec_H2_closer("impression", "impression") == "the impression version's prediction is closer",
  dec_H2_closer("tone", "tone") == "the tone version's prediction is closer",
  dec_H2_closer("impression", "neither") == "not distinguished", dec_H2_closer("impression", "tone") == "not distinguished",
  dec_4b(lr_4b(.30, .118)) == "the E effect is closer to the impression version's prediction",
  dec_4b(lr_4b(-.10, .118)) == "the E effect is closer to the tone version's prediction",
  dec_4b(lr_4b(.085, .118)) == "not distinguished", abs(lr_4b(.085, .118) - 1) < 1e-12,
  dec_H4(.60, c(.1, .1, .1), c(-.3, -.3, -.3)) == "supported", dec_H4(.30, c(-.4, -.1, -.1), c(.05, -.2, -.2)) == "contradicted",
  dec_H4(.60, c(.1, -.1, .1), c(-.3, -.1, -.3)) == "inconclusive", dec_H4(.30, c(-.1, -.1, -.1), c(-.1, -.1, -.1)) == "inconclusive",
  dec_D1(.50, .01, FALSE, FALSE) == "accumulation", dec_D1(-.50, .01, FALSE, FALSE) == "narrowing",
  dec_D1(.05, .60, TRUE, FALSE) == "first impression", dec_D1(.20, .03, TRUE, FALSE) == "first impression, with small growth",
  dec_D1(-.20, .03, TRUE, FALSE) == "first impression, with small narrowing", dec_D1(.10, .50, FALSE, FALSE) == "inconclusive",
  dec_D1(.50, .01, TRUE, TRUE) == "accumulation", dec_D1(.50, .01, FALSE, TRUE) == "accumulation",
  dec_D1(-.50, .01, FALSE, TRUE) == "not interpretable: scale bound", dec_D1(.05, .60, TRUE, TRUE) == "not interpretable: scale bound",
  dec_D1(-.20, .03, TRUE, TRUE) == "not interpretable: scale bound", dec_D1(.10, .50, FALSE, TRUE) == "inconclusive",
  dec_R2cd(c(.2, .2, .2, .2, .5, .5)) == "supported", dec_R2cd(c(.2, .2, .2, .5, .5, .5)) == "inconclusive",
  dec_R2cd(c(3.5, .2, .2, .2, .2, .2)) == "contradicted",
  dec_R2cd(c(rep(.2, 5), .5, .5, .5)) == "supported", dec_R2cd(c(rep(.2, 4), rep(.5, 4))) == "inconclusive",
  dec_R3(.25, -.05, .5) == "supported", dec_R3(.35, .22, .5) == "contradicted", dec_R3(.25, -.05, 2) == "inconclusive", dec_R3(.33, .02, .5) == "inconclusive",
  dec_R4(.2, .10) == "supported", dec_R4(4, .10) == "contradicted", dec_R4(.2, .26) == "contradicted", dec_R4(1, .10) == "inconclusive",
  dec_R6a(.45, 1.1) == "company-primary", dec_R6a(-.2, .35) == "Sylva comparable to the company", dec_R6a(.2, .7) == "inconclusive",
  sup(TRUE) == "supported", sup(FALSE) == "not supported", sup(NA) == "not supported", pass(TRUE) == "passes", pass(FALSE) == "fails",
  is.null(vers_cov(tibble(experiment_version = c("v1", "v1")))), vers_cov(tibble(experiment_version = c("v1", "v2"))) == "experiment_version")
# the version covariate enters the H1 model when > 1 version (§7.2 H1, §11.1)
toy <- tibble(A = rep(c(-.5, .5), 20), E = rep(c(-.5, -.5, .5, .5), 10), experiment_version = rep(c("v1", "v2"), each = 20), y = rnorm(40))
stopifnot("experiment_versionv2" %in% names(coef(core(toy, "y", vers_cov(toy)))))
cat("All decision-rule checks passed.\n")
```

# 1. Data (Prereg §6.12 fields; build v0.3 column names)

```{r data-generate}
tick("data")
source(file.path(S3R, "study3_mock_generator.R"))   # also provides parse_prereg_materials() and harness_header()
P <- s3_paths(params$analysis_root)
stopifnot(grepl("Study3_Preregistration_FINAL", P$prereg))   # the posted preregistration is the specification
MAT <- parse_prereg_materials(P$prereg)
BUILD_HEADER <- harness_header(P$harness)
# Appendix D.1 (revision 3): word counts and fixed frozen-probe scores of the scripted turns, and expected script hashes
parse_d1 <- function(path) {
  L <- readLines(path, encoding = "UTF-8", warn = FALSE)
  map <- c("Warm, outgoing" = "HighA_HighE", "Warm, reserved" = "HighA_LowE", "Cold, outgoing" = "LowA_HighE", "Cold, reserved" = "LowA_LowE")
  i <- grep("^\\| Cell \\| S0 words \\| S1 words \\| Warmth probe", L); stopifnot(length(i) == 1)
  tab <- map_dfr(L[(i + 2):(i + 5)], function(r) {
    f <- trimws(strsplit(r, "|", fixed = TRUE)[[1]][-1]); w <- as.numeric(strsplit(f[4], "/")[[1]]); rr <- as.numeric(strsplit(f[5], "/")[[1]])
    tibble(cell = unname(map[sub(" \\(.*$", "", f[1])]), S0_words = as.numeric(f[2]), S1_words = as.numeric(f[3]),
           W_S0 = w[1], W_S1 = w[2], W_mean = w[3], R_S0 = rr[1], R_S1 = rr[2]) })
  h <- grep("^Expected `script_sha256`", L, value = TRUE); stopifnot(length(h) == 1)
  m <- regmatches(h, gregexpr("(HighA|LowA)_(HighE|LowE) `[0-9a-f]{64}`", h))[[1]]
  list(table = tab, script_sha = setNames(sub(".*`([0-9a-f]{64})`", "\\1", m), sub(" .*", "", m)))
}
D1MAT <- parse_d1(P$prereg)
stopifnot(setequal(D1MAT$table$cell, CELLS), setequal(names(D1MAT$script_sha), CELLS))
# ΔW_script (§8.8 D1 interpretation): warm - cold gap in the fixed probe-W scores of S0 and S1 (about .52)
DW_SCRIPT <- with(D1MAT$table, mean(W_mean[startsWith(cell, "HighA")]) - mean(W_mean[startsWith(cell, "LowA")]))
if (params$data_mode == "mock") {
  EFF <- switch(params$effects, planted = planted_effects(), null = null_effects())
  sim <- simulate_study3(EFF, params$analysis_root, seed = params$sim_seed)
  raw_dir <- file.path(tempdir(), paste0("s3_raw_", params$effects))
  unlink(raw_dir, recursive = TRUE); write_session_csvs(sim$records, raw_dir)
  tone_turns <- sim$tone; nlp_turns <- sim$turns; nlp_flags <- sim$flags; nlp_rel <- sim$reliability
  TRUTH <- population_truth(EFF, sim$donors)
  catg("SYNTHETIC data: {length(sim$records)} session records ({params$effects} effects, generator seed {params$sim_seed}); ",
           "{nrow(tone_turns)} scored model replies; {nrow(nlp_turns)} coded chat turns.")
} else {
  raw_dir <- params$raw_dir
  tone_turns <- read.csv(params$tone_file, colClasses = c(sona_id = "character"))
  nlp_turns  <- read.csv(params$nlp_turn_file, colClasses = c(sona_id = "character"))
  nlp_flags  <- read.csv(params$nlp_flag_file, colClasses = c(sona_id = "character"))
  nlp_rel    <- read.csv(params$nlp_reliability_file)
  TRUTH <- NULL
}
catg("ΔW_script (Appendix D.1) = {f3(DW_SCRIPT)}.")
set.seed(42)   # analysis seed (generation used its own stream)
```

```{r data-load}
# One CSV per session (complete: ..._SESSION_<ts>.csv; partial: ..._PARTIAL.csv / _PARTIAL_MIN.csv). Every column read
# as character with readr (hyphenated item_order_* names kept, §6.12); CRLF -> LF in every text field (§6.9).
read_pavlovia <- function(dir) {
  files <- list.files(dir, pattern = "\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)
  map_dfr(files, function(f) readr::read_csv(f, col_types = readr::cols(.default = readr::col_character()),
                                             progress = FALSE, show_col_types = FALSE) %>% mutate(source_file = basename(f))) %>%
    mutate(across(everything(), ~ gsub("\r\n", "\n", .x, fixed = TRUE)))
}
raw_dl <- read_pavlovia(raw_dir)
# §9.2 criterion 10, applied first at download: a record reporting an age under 18 (d_age numeric and below 18) is
# deleted before any other step; only the count is kept (CONSORT).
age_dl <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(raw_dl$d_age))
minor <- !is.na(age_dl) & age_dl < 18
N_DOWNLOAD <- nrow(raw_dl); N_MINOR <- sum(minor)
raw <- raw_dl[!minor, ]; rm(raw_dl, age_dl, minor)
to_lgl <- function(x) case_when(tolower(x) == "true" ~ TRUE, tolower(x) == "false" ~ FALSE, TRUE ~ NA)
LGL <- c("completed", "captcha_pass", "attn1_pass", "attn1_retry_pass", "comprehension_correct", "is_test_session",
         "system_prompt_sha256_match", "script_sha256_match", "cb_reused", "pid_mismatch", "pavlovia_pilot_mode",
         "partial_slim", "partial_min", "chat_min_message_threshold_met")
NUM <- c(grep("^(tipi_self|tipi_bot|gaais|phq4|psr|ec|tr|et|ma|mp|liab)_[0-9]+$", names(raw), value = TRUE),
         "mc_extraversion", "mc_agreeableness", "mc_neuroticism", "mc_e_energetic", "mc_length",
         paste0("ios_t", 1:3), paste0("ios_t", 1:3, "_elapsed"), paste0("ios_t", 1:3, "_round"), paste0("ios_t", 1:3, "_rt_ms"),
         "chat_total_rounds", "chat_send_attempts", "chat_llm_rounds", "chat_api_error_count", "chat_idle_pause_count",
         "chat_probe_seconds", "chat_after_end_replies", "chat_duration_seconds", "cb_slot", "study_id", "reload_count",
         grep("^v2_(resp|cause|oblig)_|^v2_severity$|^v2_page_ms$|^v2_items_page_ms$", names(raw), value = TRUE),
         "d_serious", "d_gender", "d_education", "d_politics", "d_ai_freq", "d_legal_knowledge", "d_jury",
         "d_free_speech_1", "d_free_speech_2", "d_chatbot_experience", "d_social_media", "d_tech_comfort", "d_tech_trust",
         "d_employment", "d_religiosity", "d_device", "d_distractions", "d_english_proficiency", "d_fullscreen",
         "d_ai_used_in_study", "attn1", "attn1_retry", "total_duration_ms")
raw <- raw %>% mutate(across(any_of(NUM), ~ suppressWarnings(as.numeric(.x))), across(any_of(LGL), to_lgl))
ts_parse <- function(x) as.POSIXct(x, format = "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%OSZ", tz = "UTC")
# §9.2: a session is one session_uuid. If a session left more than one record, keep its completed record, else the latest partial.
n_rec <- nrow(raw)
if (!"checkpoint_ts" %in% names(raw)) raw$checkpoint_ts <- NA_character_
if (!"checkpoint_stage" %in% names(raw)) raw$checkpoint_stage <- NA_character_
raw <- raw %>% mutate(.row = row_number(), .ck = ts_parse(checkpoint_ts)) %>% group_by(session_uuid) %>%
  arrange(desc(completed %in% TRUE), desc(.ck), .by_group = TRUE) %>% filter(row_number() == 1) %>% ungroup() %>%
  arrange(.row) %>% select(-.row, -.ck)
catg("Downloaded {N_DOWNLOAD} records; {N_MINOR} deleted at download (criterion 10); {n_rec} records = {nrow(raw)} sessions ",
         "({sum(grepl('_PARTIAL', raw$source_file))} partial).")
# §11.2 posting rule applied to the synthetic raw file: user_agent and the demographic free-text fields removed; sona_id and
# pid_url replaced by random codes (system_prompt is also dropped, for size; its hash is kept). Chat transcripts and open-ended
# answers are kept: with real data they are posted only after every identifying detail has been removed by hand (§11.2).
if (params$data_mode == "mock") {
  ids <- sort(unique(na.omit(c(raw$sona_id, raw$pid_url))))
  set.seed(9042); code <- setNames(sprintf("R%05d", sample.int(99999, length(ids))), ids); set.seed(42)
  public <- raw %>% select(-any_of(c("d_problems", "d_native_language", "d_country", "d_occupation", "d_religion",
                                     "d_final_thoughts", "user_agent", "system_prompt", "source_file"))) %>%
    mutate(sona_id = unname(code[sona_id]), pid_url = unname(code[pid_url]))
  readr::write_csv(public, file.path(OUT, paste0(TAG, "_raw_sessions_synthetic.csv.gz")))
  rm(public, ids, code)
}
```

```{r contract}
dyn <- c("attn1_retry_pass", "checkpoint_stage", "checkpoint_ts", "partial_slim", "partial_min")   # written only on some pages / records
contract <- tibble(field = prereg_fields,
                   in_build_header = field %in% BUILD_HEADER | field %in% dyn,
                   in_this_data = field %in% names(raw),
                   note = case_when(field %in% documented_never_written ~ "§6.8: never written (expected absent)",
                                    field %in% dyn & !field %in% names(raw) ~ "written only in some records (none in these data)",
                                    TRUE ~ ""))
kt(contract %>% filter((!in_build_header | !in_this_data)), "Revision-3 raw fields absent from the build header or from these data")
```

## 1.2 Prompt and script integrity (§3.4, §6.9, §6.12, Appendix A, Appendix D.1)

```{r hashes}
sha <- function(x) vapply(x, function(s) if (is.na(s)) NA_character_ else as.character(openssl::sha256(enc2utf8(s))), character(1))
d1_text_sha <- sha(map_chr(CELLS, ~ paste0(MAT$scripts[[.x]][["S0"]], "\n", MAT$scripts[[.x]][["S1"]])))
names(d1_text_sha) <- CELLS
kt(tibble(cell = CELLS, prompt_sha_recomputed_from_3.4 = unname(sha(unlist(MAT$prompts[CELLS]))) == unname(MAT$expected_prompt_sha[CELLS]),
          script_sha_recomputed_from_D1_texts = unname(d1_text_sha) == unname(D1MAT$script_sha[CELLS])),
   "Registered texts reproduce the registered hashes (Appendix A; Appendix D.1)")
stopifnot(all(sha(unlist(MAT$prompts[CELLS])) == MAT$expected_prompt_sha[CELLS]), all(d1_text_sha == D1MAT$script_sha[CELLS]))
integ <- raw %>% filter(!is.na(system_prompt)) %>%
  transmute(session_uuid, cell, logged = system_prompt_sha256, recomputed_lf = sha(system_prompt),
            logged_matches_appA = logged == unname(MAT$expected_prompt_sha[cell]), match_field = system_prompt_sha256_match,
            script_logged_matches_D1 = script_sha256 == unname(D1MAT$script_sha[cell]), script_match_field = script_sha256_match)
kt(integ %>% summarise(n = n(), logged_prompt_hash_in_appA = sum(logged_matches_appA), system_prompt_sha256_match_TRUE = sum(match_field %in% TRUE),
                        recomputed_after_CRLF_normalisation = sum(sha(raw$system_prompt[!is.na(raw$system_prompt)]) == logged),
                        script_hash_matches_D1 = sum(script_logged_matches_D1), script_sha256_match_TRUE = sum(script_match_field %in% TRUE)),
   "Logged prompt and script hashes (sessions that store system_prompt)")
stopifnot(identical(integ$logged_matches_appA, integ$match_field %in% TRUE))
cat("Without the §6.9 CRLF normalisation the recomputed hash would match in",
    sum(sha(gsub("\n", "\r\n", raw$system_prompt[!is.na(raw$system_prompt)], fixed = TRUE)) == integ$logged, na.rm = TRUE), "sessions (expected 0).\n")
```

# 2. Exclusions (Prereg §9.2) and samples

```{r exclusions}
tick("exclusions")
ex <- raw %>% mutate(
  t_first = ts_parse(consent_ts),                                   # rule 3: 'first' = earliest consent_ts
  reached_chat = !is.na(chat_start_time) & chat_start_time != "",   # rule 3: reached the chat = chat_start_time non-empty
  e1_test = grepl("^test", sona_id, ignore.case = TRUE) | cb_source %in% "test" | is_test_session %in% TRUE | pavlovia_pilot_mode %in% TRUE,
  e2_incomplete = !(completed %in% TRUE))
# Rule 3 (repeat participation): among records that reached the chat (complete or partial), only the SONA ID's first such
# session is eligible, and only if complete; sessions that ended before the chat are ignored. sona_id is character.
rep_rank <- ex %>% filter(!e1_test, reached_chat, !is.na(sona_id)) %>% arrange(sona_id, t_first) %>%
  group_by(sona_id) %>% mutate(chat_rank = row_number(), n_chat_sessions = n()) %>% ungroup() %>%
  select(session_uuid, chat_rank, n_chat_sessions)
ex <- ex %>% left_join(rep_rank, by = "session_uuid") %>% mutate(
  e3_repeat   = !is.na(chat_rank) & chat_rank > 1,
  e4_attn     = (attn1_pass %in% FALSE) & (attn1_retry_pass %in% FALSE),
  e5_comp     = comprehension_correct %in% FALSE,
  e6_captcha  = captcha_pass %in% FALSE,
  e7_ai       = d_ai_used_in_study %in% 1,
  e8_serious  = d_serious %in% 1,
  e9_prior    = prior_sylva %in% "Yes")
rules <- c(e1_test = "1. TEST or pilot session", e2_incomplete = "2. Incomplete session", e3_repeat = "3. Repeat participation",
           e4_attn = "4. Failed attention check (both attempts)", e5_comp = "5. Failed comprehension check",
           e6_captcha = "6. Failed CAPTCHA", e7_ai = "7. Self-reported AI use", e8_serious = "8. Non-serious responding",
           e9_prior = "9. Prior Sylva study")
M <- as.matrix(ex[, names(rules)]); first_hit <- apply(M, 1, function(r) if (any(r)) names(rules)[which(r)[1]] else NA)
ex$excl_first <- first_hit
flow <- tibble(step = c("Records at download", "10. Reported age under 18 (deleted at download; applied first)", "Session records",
                        unname(rules), "Analytic sample"),
               n = c(N_DOWNLOAD, N_MINOR, nrow(ex), map_int(names(rules), ~ sum(first_hit == .x, na.rm = TRUE)), sum(is.na(first_hit))))
kt(flow, "CONSORT flow (§9.2: criterion 10 first, then each record counted under the first criterion met)")
save_tab(flow, "consort_flow")
catg("Pilot-link sessions (pavlovia_pilot_mode = TRUE): {sum(ex$pavlovia_pilot_mode %in% TRUE)}; ",
         "incomplete records whose last checkpoint was the debrief page (§9.2 rule 2): {sum(ex$e2_incomplete & grepl('debrief', coalesce(ex$checkpoint_stage, '')))}.")
kt(ex %>% filter(!e1_test, sona_id %in% sona_id[duplicated(sona_id)]) %>% arrange(sona_id, t_first) %>%
     transmute(sona_id = "(masked)", cell, completed, reached_chat, chat_rank, excl_first), "Records sharing a SONA ID (§9.2 rule 3), with cells")
D0 <- ex %>% filter(is.na(excl_first))
FULL <- ex %>% filter(!e1_test, !e2_incomplete, !e3_repeat)      # §9.1 check 3: only TEST/pilot, incomplete and repeat sessions removed
catg("Analytic N = {nrow(D0)}; full sample (check 3) N = {nrow(FULL)}.")
```

# 3. Recodes (§9.3), composites (§6), derived variables (§6.9-§6.15)

```{r recodes-composites}
tick("variables")
age_num <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(D0$d_age))
D0$d_age_clean <- ifelse(!is.na(age_num) & age_num == round(age_num) & age_num >= 18 & age_num <= 100, age_num, NA_real_)
catg("Age (§9.3): {sum(is.na(D0$d_age_clean) & !is.na(D0$d_age))} entr(ies) not a whole number from 18 to 100 set to missing.")
pnts <- c(d_gender = 5, d_education = 8, d_politics = 8, d_jury = 3, d_employment = 9, d_religiosity = 6)
for (v in names(pnts)) D0[[v]][D0[[v]] %in% pnts[[v]]] <- NA

score <- function(d) d %>% mutate(
  A = ifelse(a_level == "high", .5, -.5), E = ifelse(e_level == "high", .5, -.5),
  O = ifelse(order == "bonding_first", .5, -.5), cell4 = paste0(a_level, "A_", e_level, "E"),
  tipi_self_extra = (tipi_self_1 + 8 - tipi_self_6) / 2, tipi_self_agree = (8 - tipi_self_2 + tipi_self_7) / 2,
  tipi_self_consc = (tipi_self_3 + 8 - tipi_self_8) / 2, tipi_self_emostab = (8 - tipi_self_4 + tipi_self_9) / 2,
  tipi_self_open = (tipi_self_5 + 8 - tipi_self_10) / 2,
  tipi_bot_extra = (tipi_bot_1 + 8 - tipi_bot_6) / 2, tipi_bot_agree = (8 - tipi_bot_2 + tipi_bot_7) / 2,
  tipi_bot_consc = (tipi_bot_3 + 8 - tipi_bot_8) / 2, tipi_bot_emostab = (8 - tipi_bot_4 + tipi_bot_9) / 2,
  tipi_bot_open = (tipi_bot_5 + 8 - tipi_bot_10) / 2,
  G = (tipi_bot_extra + tipi_bot_agree + tipi_bot_consc + tipi_bot_emostab + tipi_bot_open) / 5,    # §6.15
  G_halo = (tipi_bot_consc + tipi_bot_emostab + tipi_bot_open) / 3,                                 # §6.15
  G_halo_E = (tipi_bot_3 + (8 - tipi_bot_8) + (8 - tipi_bot_4) + (8 - tipi_bot_10)) / 4,            # §6.15: without items 5 and 9
  G_c_es = (tipi_bot_consc + tipi_bot_emostab) / 2, G_c_o = (tipi_bot_consc + tipi_bot_open) / 2,   # §8.6 composition
  G_es_o = (tipi_bot_emostab + tipi_bot_open) / 2,
  psr_total = rowMeans(across(paste0("psr_", 1:12))), psr_connection = rowMeans(across(paste0("psr_", 1:4))),
  psr_desire = rowMeans(across(paste0("psr_", 5:8))), psr_caring = rowMeans(across(paste0("psr_", 9:12))),
  ec_total = rowMeans(across(paste0("ec_", 1:5))), trust_total = rowMeans(across(paste0("tr_", 1:4))),
  et_total = rowMeans(across(paste0("et_", 1:8))), ma_total = rowMeans(across(paste0("ma_", 1:8))),
  ma_cap = rowMeans(across(paste0("ma_", c(1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 7)))),                                   # §6.15: without ma_5, ma_8
  mp_total = rowMeans(across(paste0("mp_", 1:8))),
  liab_corp = rowMeans(across(paste0("liab_", 1:5))), liab_chat = rowMeans(across(paste0("liab_", 6:8))),
  liab_user = rowMeans(across(paste0("liab_", 9:10))), liab_harm = rowMeans(across(paste0("liab_", 11:12))),
  # §6.15 bonding composite B: z-scored in the (analytic) sample, mean re-standardised
  B = zs((zs(psr_total) + zs(ec_total) + zs(trust_total)) / 3),
  phq4_total = phq4_1 + phq4_2 + phq4_3 + phq4_4, phq4_anx = phq4_1 + phq4_2, phq4_dep = phq4_3 + phq4_4,
  gaais_pos = (gaais_1 + gaais_2 + gaais_3 + gaais_4 + gaais_5 + gaais_6 + gaais_7 + gaais_8 + gaais_9 + 6 - gaais_10) / 10,
  gaais_neg = (gaais_11 + gaais_12 + gaais_13 + gaais_14 + gaais_15 + gaais_16 + gaais_17 + gaais_18 + 6 - gaais_19 + 6 - gaais_20) / 10,
  v2_company = (v2_resp_company + v2_cause_company + v2_oblig_company) / 3,
  v2_sylva = (v2_resp_sylva + v2_cause_sylva + v2_oblig_sylva) / 3,
  v2_user = (v2_resp_user + v2_cause_user + v2_oblig_user) / 3,
  gap_v1 = liab_1 - liab_6, gap_v2 = v2_resp_company - v2_resp_sylva,
  disc_company = v2_cause_company - v2_resp_company, disc_sylva = v2_cause_sylva - v2_resp_sylva,
  disc_user = v2_cause_user - v2_resp_user,
  ios_change = ios_t3 - ios_t1)
D0 <- score(D0); FULL <- score(FULL)
```

```{r chat-derived}
# §6.9: computed from chat_log after removing system_error entries. Model-generated replies = assistant entries without the
# scripted flag, round >= 2, excluding after_end = true & displayed = false (included: after_end = true & displayed = true).
# Participant turns = role 'user' (the injected opener, 'user_scripted', excluded; failed sends included).
chat_feats <- function(js) {
  L <- if (is.na(js)) NULL else tryCatch(fromJSON(js, simplifyVector = FALSE), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(L)) return(tibble(.ok = FALSE, incl_rounds = list(numeric(0))))
  L <- Filter(function(e) !identical(e$role, "system_error"), L)
  asst <- Filter(function(e) identical(e$role, "assistant") && !isTRUE(e$scripted) && as.numeric(e$round) >= 2, L)
  nd <- map_lgl(asst, ~ isTRUE(.x$after_end) && identical(.x$displayed, FALSE))
  bot <- asst[!nd]
  usr <- Filter(function(e) identical(e$role, "user"), L)
  wc <- function(s) length(strsplit(trimws(s), "\\s+")[[1]])
  tok <- map_dbl(bot, ~ if (!is.null(.x$usage$completion_tokens)) as.numeric(.x$usage$completion_tokens) else NA_real_)
  bw <- map_dbl(bot, ~ wc(.x$content)); rd <- map_dbl(bot, ~ as.numeric(.x$round))
  fin <- map_chr(bot, ~ if (is.null(.x$finish_reason)) NA_character_ else as.character(.x$finish_reason))
  u1 <- Filter(function(e) identical(as.numeric(e$round), 1), usr)
  first <- if (length(bot)) which.min(rd) else integer(0)
  tibble(.ok = TRUE, n_model_replies = length(bot), n_nondisplayed = sum(nd), n_no_usage = sum(is.na(tok)),
         incl_rounds = list(rd),
         bot_tokens_per_turn = if (all(is.na(tok))) NA_real_ else mean(tok, na.rm = TRUE),
         bot_words_per_reply = if (length(bw)) mean(bw) else NA_real_,
         first_reply_tokens = if (length(bot)) tok[first] else NA_real_,       # §8.4: earliest displayed model reply, any round
         first_reply_words = if (length(bot)) bw[first] else NA_real_,
         bot_q_per_reply = if (length(bot)) mean(map_dbl(bot, ~ str_count(.x$content, fixed("?")))) else NA_real_,
         bot_excl_per_reply = if (length(bot)) mean(map_dbl(bot, ~ str_count(.x$content, fixed("!")))) else NA_real_,
         bot_sent_per_reply = if (length(bot)) mean(map_dbl(bot, ~ max(1, str_count(.x$content, "[.!?]+")))) else NA_real_,
         n_after_end = sum(map_lgl(bot, ~ isTRUE(.x$after_end))),
         n_finish_not_stop = sum(is.na(fin) | fin != "stop"),                 # §6.9: a missing value counts as not 'stop'
         n_finish_missing = sum(is.na(fin)), n_finish_length = sum(fin %in% "length"),
         n_user_turns = length(usr),
         user_chars_per_turn = if (length(usr)) mean(nchar(map_chr(usr, "content"))) else NA_real_,
         user_total_chars = sum(nchar(map_chr(usr, "content"))),
         user_words_per_turn = if (length(usr)) mean(map_dbl(usr, ~ wc(.x$content))) else NA_real_,
         user_tokens_per_turn = if (length(usr)) mean(nchar(map_chr(usr, "content")) / 4) else NA_real_,
         first_msg_question = if (length(u1)) grepl("?", u1[[1]]$content, fixed = TRUE) else NA)
}
add_chat <- function(d) {
  cf <- map_dfr(d$chat_log, chat_feats)
  d <- bind_cols(d, cf) %>% mutate(any_finish_not_stop = n_finish_not_stop > 0,
                                   chat_wallclock_seconds = as.numeric(difftime(ts_parse(chat_end_time), ts_parse(chat_start_time), units = "secs")))
  incl <- d %>% select(session_uuid, incl_rounds) %>% unnest_longer(incl_rounds, values_to = "turn_idx")
  # §6.10.1: W, R, A = mean frozen-probe probability over the participant's model-generated replies (§6.9), joined on session_uuid
  tp <- tone_turns %>% semi_join(incl, by = c("session_uuid", "turn_idx")) %>% group_by(session_uuid) %>%
    summarise(W_bar = mean(W), R_bar = mean(R), A_bar = mean(A), n_scored = n(), .groups = "drop")
  # §6.11: pct_emotional_self_disclosure = coded participant turns / participant turns (joined on session_uuid, §6.10)
  nu <- nlp_turns %>% filter(role == "user") %>% group_by(session_uuid) %>%
    summarise(pct_emotional_self_disclosure = mean(emotional_self_disclosure), .groups = "drop")
  d %>% left_join(tp, by = "session_uuid") %>% left_join(nu, by = "session_uuid") %>%
    left_join(nlp_flags %>% select(-sona_id), by = "session_uuid")
}
D0 <- add_chat(D0); FULL <- add_chat(FULL)
D <- D0
stopifnot(all(D$n_scored == D$n_model_replies, na.rm = TRUE))
kt(D %>% group_by(cell) %>% summarise(n = n(), model_replies = sum(n_model_replies), excluded_displayed_false = sum(n_nondisplayed),
                                      replies_without_usage = sum(n_no_usage), replies_without_finish_reason = sum(n_finish_missing),
                                      participants_without_model_reply = sum(is.na(W_bar)), .groups = "drop"),
   "§6.9 / §7.5 by cell: model-generated replies, excluded late replies (displayed = false), replies without token usage")
catg("Analytic sample: N = {nrow(D)}; cells: {paste(names(table(D$cell)), table(D$cell), sep = ' = ', collapse = ', ')}; ",
         "orders: {paste(names(table(D$order)), table(D$order), sep = ' = ', collapse = ', ')}.")
kt(D %>% group_by(cell) %>% summarise(n = n(), PSR = mean(psr_total), Corp = mean(liab_corp), W_bar = mean(W_bar, na.rm = TRUE),
                                      G_halo = mean(G_halo), G_halo_E = mean(G_halo_E), ios_t1 = mean(ios_t1),
                                      tokens = mean(bot_tokens_per_turn, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop"),
   "Cell means (analytic sample)", 2)
```

# 4. Reliability (§9.4)

```{r reliability}
tick("reliability")
rel_sets <- list(PSR = paste0("psr_", 1:12), PSR_connection = paste0("psr_", 1:4), PSR_desire = paste0("psr_", 5:8),
  PSR_caring = paste0("psr_", 9:12), EC = paste0("ec_", 1:5), Trust = paste0("tr_", 1:4), ET = paste0("et_", 1:8),
  MA = paste0("ma_", 1:8), MA_cap = paste0("ma_", c(1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 7)), MP = paste0("mp_", 1:8), Corp = paste0("liab_", 1:5),
  Chat = paste0("liab_", 6:8), User = paste0("liab_", 9:10), Harm = paste0("liab_", 11:12), PHQ4 = paste0("phq4_", 1:4),
  V2_company = c("v2_resp_company", "v2_cause_company", "v2_oblig_company"),
  V2_sylva = c("v2_resp_sylva", "v2_cause_sylva", "v2_oblig_sylva"), V2_user = c("v2_resp_user", "v2_cause_user", "v2_oblig_user"),
  G_traits = c("tipi_bot_extra", "tipi_bot_agree", "tipi_bot_consc", "tipi_bot_emostab", "tipi_bot_open"),
  G_halo_traits = c("tipi_bot_consc", "tipi_bot_emostab", "tipi_bot_open"),
  G_halo_E_items = c("tipi_bot_3", "tipi_bot_8_r", "tipi_bot_4_r", "tipi_bot_10_r"),
  B_components = c("z_psr", "z_ec", "z_tr"))
Drel <- D %>% mutate(g10r = 6 - gaais_10, g19r = 6 - gaais_19, g20r = 6 - gaais_20, z_psr = zs(psr_total), z_ec = zs(ec_total), z_tr = zs(trust_total),
                     across(c(tipi_bot_6, tipi_bot_2, tipi_bot_8, tipi_bot_4, tipi_bot_10, tipi_self_6, tipi_self_2, tipi_self_8, tipi_self_4, tipi_self_10), ~ 8 - .x, .names = "{.col}_r"))
rel_sets$GAAIS_pos <- c(paste0("gaais_", 1:9), "g10r"); rel_sets$GAAIS_neg <- c(paste0("gaais_", 11:18), "g19r", "g20r")
for (k in list(c("extra", 1, "6_r"), c("agree", "2_r", 7), c("consc", 3, "8_r"), c("emostab", "4_r", 9), c("open", 5, "10_r"))) {
  rel_sets[[paste0("TIPIbot_", k[1])]] <- paste0("tipi_bot_", k[2:3]); rel_sets[[paste0("TIPIself_", k[1])]] <- paste0("tipi_self_", k[2:3])
}
reliab <- map_dfr(names(rel_sets), function(s) {
  X <- Drel[, rel_sets[[s]]]; X <- X[complete.cases(X), ]
  set.seed(42)
  a <- tryCatch(suppressWarnings(psych::alpha(X, check.keys = FALSE, n.iter = 1000, warnings = FALSE)), error = function(e) NULL)
  om <- if (ncol(X) >= 3) tryCatch(suppressWarnings(psych::omega(X, nfactors = 1, plot = FALSE, warnings = FALSE))$omega.tot, error = function(e) NA_real_) else NA_real_
  tibble(composite = s, k = ncol(X), alpha = if (is.null(a)) NA else a$total$raw_alpha,
         alpha_lo = if (is.null(a) || is.null(a$boot.ci)) NA else a$boot.ci[1], alpha_hi = if (is.null(a) || is.null(a$boot.ci)) NA else a$boot.ci[3],
         omega = om, r_items = if (ncol(X) == 2) cor(X[[1]], X[[2]]) else NA_real_)
}) %>% mutate(flag = case_when(grepl("^V2_", composite) ~ "descriptive: mixes responsibility, cause and obligation (§9.4)",
                               alpha < .70 ~ "alpha < .70: interpret with reliability stated", TRUE ~ ""))
kt(reliab, "§9.4: Cronbach's alpha (1,000-resample bootstrap 95% CI); omega for k >= 3; inter-item r for k = 2; G, G_halo, G_halo_E and B over their components")
save_tab(reliab, "reliability")
```

# 5. Manipulation checks (§8.1)

```{r mc}
tick("manipulation")
mc_one <- function(y, f, d = D) { fit <- core(d, y); bind_cols(tibble(outcome = y, factor = f), hc3(fit, f) %>% select(b, lo, hi, p, n), g_marg(d, y, f)) }
mc_primary <- bind_rows(mc_one("tipi_bot_agree", "A") %>% mutate(check = "MC-A"), mc_one("tipi_bot_extra", "E") %>% mutate(check = "MC-E")) %>%
  mutate(pass = p < .05 & b > 0)
mc_supp <- bind_rows(mc_one("mc_agreeableness", "A"), mc_one("mc_extraversion", "E")) %>% mutate(check = "supplemental", pass = p < .05 & b > 0)
mc_desc <- bind_rows(mc_one("mc_e_energetic", "E"), mc_one("mc_length", "A"), mc_one("mc_length", "E")) %>% mutate(check = "descriptive", pass = NA)
diffusion <- bind_rows(mc_one("tipi_bot_extra", "A"), mc_one("mc_extraversion", "A"), mc_one("tipi_bot_agree", "E"), mc_one("mc_agreeableness", "E"),
                       mc_one("tipi_bot_emostab", "A"), mc_one("tipi_bot_emostab", "E"), mc_one("mc_neuroticism", "A"), mc_one("mc_neuroticism", "E")) %>%
  mutate(check = "diffusion (Bonferroni .00625)", pass = NA, diffusion = p < .05 / 8)
MC <- bind_rows(mc_primary, mc_supp, mc_desc, diffusion)
kt(MC %>% select(check, outcome, factor, b, lo, hi, p, g, g_lo, g_hi, pass, diffusion), "Manipulation checks (core model, HC3)")
MC_A_pass <- mc_primary$pass[mc_primary$check == "MC-A"]; MC_E_pass <- mc_primary$pass[mc_primary$check == "MC-E"]
# Discriminant criterion: g(target subscale) - g(other manipulated trait's subscale), within-cell bootstrap (informative, not a gate)
BI <- boot_idx(D$cell4)
disc_stat <- function(d, f, tgt, oth) g_fast(d[[tgt]][d[[f]] > 0], d[[tgt]][d[[f]] < 0]) - g_fast(d[[oth]][d[[f]] > 0], d[[oth]][d[[f]] < 0])
discrim <- map_dfr(list(c("A", "tipi_bot_agree", "tipi_bot_extra"), c("E", "tipi_bot_extra", "tipi_bot_agree")), function(z) {
  est <- disc_stat(D, z[1], z[2], z[3]); bs <- map_dbl(BI, ~ disc_stat(D[.x, ], z[1], z[2], z[3]))
  tibble(factor = z[1], diff_g = est, lo = q95(bs)[1], hi = q95(bs)[2], met = q95(bs)[1] > 0 | q95(bs)[2] < 0)
})
kt(discrim, "Discriminant criterion (informative, not a gate)")
stopifnot(abs(g_fast(D$psr_total[D$A > 0], D$psr_total[D$A < 0]) - g_marg(D, "psr_total", "A")$g) < 1e-8)
mc_by_order <- map_dfr(c("impression_first", "bonding_first"), function(o) bind_rows(
  mc_one("tipi_bot_agree", "A", D[D$order == o, ]), mc_one("tipi_bot_extra", "E", D[D$order == o, ]),
  mc_one("mc_agreeableness", "A", D[D$order == o, ]), mc_one("mc_extraversion", "E", D[D$order == o, ])) %>% mutate(order = o))
kt(mc_by_order %>% select(order, outcome, factor, b, lo, hi, p, g), "Primary and supplemental checks by measurement order (§8.1: reported pooled and by order)")
if (!MC_E_pass) cat("MC-E fails: H2 is reported as an estimate for the extraversion instruction, not for perceived extraversion; H5 is not computed (§8.1).\n")
if (!MC_A_pass) cat("MC-A fails: H1 is reported as an estimate for the warmth instruction, not for perceived warmth (§8.1).\n")
save_tab(MC, "manipulation_checks")
```

# 6. Primary hypotheses (§7.2)

## 6.1 H1: warmth -> PSR

```{r h1}
tick("H1")
VC <- vers_cov(D)   # §7.2 H1, §11.1: NULL unless sessions ran under more than one experiment_version
if (!is.null(VC)) cat("More than one experiment_version: added to the H1, H2 and model-based R2 models as a fixed covariate (§11.1).\n")
fitP <- core(D, "psr_total", VC)
h1 <- hc3(fitP, "A"); g1 <- g_marg(D, "psr_total", "A"); fd1 <- fact_d(fitP, "A")
bf1 <- bf_reg(D, "psr_total", "A"); bf1m <- bf_marg(D, "psr_total", "A"); bf1p <- bf_marg(D, "psr_total", "A", TRUE)
tost1 <- tost_f(D, "psr_total", "A", .40, "SMD")
H1_dec <- dec_H1(h1$b, h1$p)
H1_strict <- h1$b > 0 & h1$p < .05 & bf1 >= 3   # pre-specified descriptor: the stricter joint criterion
H1_tab <- bind_cols(h1, g1, fd1, tibble(BF10_registered = bf1, BF10_cat = bf_cat(bf1), BF10_ttest = bf1m, BF10_ttest_cat = bf_cat(bf1m), BFplus0 = bf1p,
                    BFplus0_cat = bf_cat(bf1p), joint_class = joint_class(tost1$equivalent, bf1), decision = H1_dec, strict_joint_met = H1_strict))
kt(H1_tab %>% select(-term, -t, -df), "H1: A coefficient of the core model on PSR")
if (!is.null(VC)) kt(map_dfr(sort(unique(D$experiment_version)), function(v) { dv <- D[D$experiment_version == v, ]
  bind_rows(hc3(core(dv, "psr_total"), "A") %>% mutate(test = "H1 b(A) on PSR"), hc3(core(dv, "psr_total"), "E") %>% mutate(test = "H2 b(E) on PSR"),
            hc3(core(dv, "liab_corp"), "A") %>% mutate(test = "R2a b(A) on Corporate Liability"), hc3(core(dv, "liab_corp"), "E") %>% mutate(test = "R2b b(E) on Corporate Liability")) %>%
    mutate(experiment_version = v) }) %>% select(experiment_version, test, b, lo, hi, p, n), "§11.1 sensitivity analyses: per-version estimates")
# Interpretation conditional on the tone gap (M1): (a)-(d)
fitW <- core(D, "W_bar"); dWA <- hc3(fitW, "A")
pred_lo <- 1.8 * dWA$b; pred_hi <- 2.0 * dWA$b
H1_tone <- tibble(dW_A = dWA$b, tone_pred_lo = pred_lo, tone_pred_hi = pred_hi,
                  a_prediction_overlaps_CI_of_b = pred_hi >= h1$lo & pred_lo <= h1$hi,
                  b_weak_tone_manipulation = dWA$b < .14 & H1_dec != "supported",
                  c_counts_against_strong_form = dWA$b >= .28 & g1$g_hi < .25,
                  c_factorial_d_alongside = fd1$d_fact_hi,
                  d_only_through_a = dWA$b >= .14 & dWA$b < .28 & H1_dec != "supported")
kt(H1_tone, "H1 interpretation conditional on M1 (§7.2 (a)-(d); (c) uses the 95% CI upper bound of Hedges's g, factorial d shown alongside)")
if (H1_tone$b_weak_tone_manipulation) cat("H1 (b): a weak tone manipulation, not evidence against the tone version.\n")
if (H1_tone$c_counts_against_strong_form) cat("H1 (c): counts against the tone version in its strong form only (§0.5).\n")
if (H1_dec == "contradicted") cat("H1 is significant in the direction opposite to the prediction: reported as contradicting H1 (§2.2).\n")
save_tab(H1_tab, "H1")
```

## 6.2 R2a / R2b: Corporate Liability equivalence

```{r r2}
tick("R2")
fitC <- core(D, "liab_corp", VC)
R2 <- map_dfr(c("A", "E"), function(f) {
  tr <- tost_f(D, "liab_corp", f, BOUND_R2, "raw"); ts <- tost_f(D, "liab_corp", f, .40, "SMD")
  h <- hc3(fitC, f); h90 <- hc3(fitC, f, .90); bf <- bf_reg(D, "liab_corp", f)
  dec <- dec_R2(tr$p_max, tr$p_t); gm <- g_marg(D, "liab_corp", f)
  tibble(hyp = ifelse(f == "A", "R2a", "R2b"), factor = f, diff = tr$diff, tost_raw_p = tr$p_max, welch_p = tr$p_t,
         decision = dec, label = lab_R2(dec, bf), tost_smd_p = ts$p_max, b = h$b, p_hc3 = h$p, ci90_lo = h90$lo, ci90_hi = h90$hi,
         ci90_within = h90$lo > -BOUND_R2 & h90$hi < BOUND_R2, g = gm$g, g_lo = gm$g_lo, g_hi = gm$g_hi,   # §7.2: g with 95% CI
         gav = tr$gav, gav_lo90 = tr$gav_lo90, gav_hi90 = tr$gav_hi90,                                     # §7.1: g(av) with 90% CI (TOST)
         BF10 = bf, BF10_cat = bf_cat(bf),
         joint_class = joint_class(tr$equivalent, bf),                 # §7.1: the raw-bound TOST that decides R2
         joint_class_smd_descriptive = joint_class(ts$equivalent, bf),
         nonzero_but_small = tr$equivalent & tr$p_t < .05)
})
kt(R2 %>% select(-factor), "R2a/R2b: Welch TOST, raw bounds ±0.40 (decision), with companions")
cat("Combined claim (RQ4): ", if (all(R2$decision == "supported")) "both R2a and R2b supported: Corporate Liability unaffected by both traits (average effects)" else
    if (any(R2$decision == "supported")) paste("only", R2$hyp[R2$decision == "supported"], "supported") else "neither supported", "\n")
if (any(R2$nonzero_but_small)) cat("Non-zero but smaller than the smallest effect of interest:", R2$hyp[R2$nonzero_but_small], "(still supported).\n")
# Interaction guard
hAEc <- hc3(fitC, "A:E")
simple <- function(d, y, f, at_f, at_v, ci) { dd <- d[d[[at_f]] == at_v, ]; g_marg(dd, y, f, ci) %>% mutate(effect = paste0(f, " at ", at_f, ifelse(at_v > 0, " high", " low"))) }
se_corp <- bind_rows(simple(D, "liab_corp", "A", "E", .5, .90), simple(D, "liab_corp", "A", "E", -.5, .90),
                     simple(D, "liab_corp", "E", "A", .5, .90), simple(D, "liab_corp", "E", "A", -.5, .90))
kt(bind_rows(tibble(effect = "A:E (HC3; raw b, 95% CI)", g = hAEc$b, g_lo = hAEc$lo, g_hi = hAEc$hi), se_corp), glue("Interaction guard: A:E (p = {fp(hAEc$p)}) and the four simple effects (g, 90% CI)"))
cat(if (hAEc$p < .05) "A:E p < .05: R2 conclusions are restricted to the average (marginal) effect, and the abstract states that the simple effects differ.\n" else
    "A:E not significant; this is not evidence that the simple effects are equivalent (power .38 at d = 0.40); R2a, R2b and the combined claim concern the average effect.\n")
save_tab(R2, "R2")
```

# 7. Estimation questions (§7.2)

## 7.1 H2: extraversion -> PSR and the model comparison

```{r h2}
tick("H2")
# Step 1: total effect, on all cases with PSR
h2 <- hc3(fitP, "E"); g2 <- g_marg(D, "psr_total", "E"); fd2 <- fact_d(fitP, "E"); bf2 <- bf_reg(D, "psr_total", "E")
bf2m <- bf_marg(D, "psr_total", "E"); bf2p <- bf_marg(D, "psr_total", "E", TRUE)
tost2 <- tost_f(D, "psr_total", "E", BOUND_PSR, "raw"); tost2s <- tost_f(D, "psr_total", "E", .40, "SMD")
H2_desc <- desc_H2(h2$b, h2$p, tost2$equivalent)
# Steps 2-5: the cases complete on PSR, W_bar and G_halo (G_halo_E is complete whenever G_halo is)
DD <- D %>% filter(!is.na(psr_total), !is.na(W_bar), !is.na(G_halo), !is.na(G_halo_E))
fitP_DD <- core(DD, "psr_total", vers_cov(DD)); h2_DD <- hc3(fitP_DD, "E"); tost2_DD <- tost_f(DD, "psr_total", "E", BOUND_PSR, "raw")
H2_desc_DD <- desc_H2(h2_DD$b, h2_DD$p, tost2_DD$equivalent)
# Step 2: the two inputs (core-model coefficients, HC3; bootstrap CIs below)
fitW_DD <- core(DD, "W_bar"); fitG_DD <- core(DD, "G_halo")
dWE <- hc3(fitW_DD, "E"); dWE90 <- hc3(fitW_DD, "E", .90); dGE <- hc3(fitG_DD, "E")
dWE_about_zero <- dWE90$lo > -.07 & dWE90$hi < .07
# Steps 3-5: within-cell slopes, each version's prediction, c', D; every quantity recomputed in each within-cell resample
X <- cbind(1, DD$A, DD$E, DD$A * DD$E)
h2_stats <- function(i) {
  Xi <- X[i, , drop = FALSE]; y <- DD$psr_total[i]; w <- DD$W_bar[i]; g <- DD$G_halo[i]; ge <- DD$G_halo_E[i]
  bE <- ols(Xi, y)[3]; dW <- ols(Xi, w)[3]; dG <- ols(Xi, g)[3]; dGEe <- ols(Xi, ge)[3]
  fW <- ols(cbind(Xi, w), y); fG <- ols(cbind(Xi, g), y); fGE <- ols(cbind(Xi, ge), y)
  PT <- fW[5] * dW; PG <- fG[5] * dG; PGE <- fGE[5] * dGEe
  c(b_E = bE, dW_E = dW, dG_E = dG, dG_E_haloE = dGEe, b_W = fW[5], b_G = fG[5], b_G_haloE = fGE[5],
    P_T = PT, P_G = PG, P_G_haloE = PGE, cprime_G = bE - PG, cprime_W = bE - PT,
    D = abs(bE - PG) - abs(bE - PT),                                  # step 4: D = |c'_G| - |c'_W|
    D_step5 = abs(bE - PGE) - abs(bE - 1.8 * dW),                     # step 5: b_W fixed at 1.8 and G_halo_E for P_G
    cprime_G_direct = fG[3], cprime_W_direct = fW[3])
}
est2 <- h2_stats(seq_len(nrow(DD)))
stopifnot(abs(est2[["cprime_G"]] - est2[["cprime_G_direct"]]) < 1e-10, abs(est2[["cprime_W"]] - est2[["cprime_W_direct"]]) < 1e-10)
BI2 <- boot_idx(DD$cell4)
bs2 <- t(vapply(BI2, h2_stats, numeric(length(est2))))
H2_boot <- tibble(quantity = names(est2), estimate = unname(est2), lo = apply(bs2, 2, q95)[1, ], hi = apply(bs2, 2, q95)[2, ]) %>%
  filter(!grepl("_direct$", quantity))
qb <- function(q) H2_boot[H2_boot$quantity == q, ]
s4 <- cmp_D(qb("D")$lo, qb("D")$hi); s5 <- cmp_D(qb("D_step5")$lo, qb("D_step5")$hi)
H2_closer <- dec_H2_closer(s4, s5)
# Step 4b: fixed-prediction comparison (P_G0 = .17, P_T0 = 0), b_E and its HC3 SE from step 1
LR <- lr_4b(h2$b, h2$se); H2_4b <- dec_4b(LR)
LR_DD <- lr_4b(h2_DD$b, h2_DD$se)
if (dec_4b(LR) != dec_4b(LR_DD)) cat("NOTE: step 4b differs between all cases and the steps 2-5 sample (see log B02).\n")
# §0.5 impression-version falsifier: ΔG_E 95% CI above 0 and c'_G bootstrap 95% CI entirely below 0
IMP_falsifier <- dGE$lo > 0 & qb("cprime_G")$hi < 0
IMP_falsifier_bootGE <- qb("dG_E")$lo > 0 & qb("cprime_G")$hi < 0
if (IMP_falsifier != IMP_falsifier_bootGE) cat("NOTE: the impression falsifier differs between HC3 and bootstrap CIs of ΔG_E (see log B01).\n")
H2_tab <- bind_cols(h2 %>% select(b, lo, hi, se, p, n), g2, fd2,
                    tibble(BF10 = bf2, BF10_ttest = bf2m, BFplus0 = bf2p, joint_class = joint_class(tost2s$equivalent, bf2),
                           tost_bound = BOUND_PSR, tost_p = tost2$p_max, description = H2_desc,
                           description_steps2to5_sample = H2_desc_DD, n_steps2to5 = nrow(DD),
                           dW_E = dWE$b, dW_E_lo = dWE$lo, dW_E_hi = dWE$hi, dW_E_lo90 = dWE90$lo, dW_E_hi90 = dWE90$hi, dW_E_about_zero = dWE_about_zero,
                           dG_E = dGE$b, dG_E_lo = dGE$lo, dG_E_hi = dGE$hi,
                           step4 = s4, step5 = s5, model_comparison = H2_closer, LR_4b = LR, step4b = H2_4b, LR_4b_steps2to5 = LR_DD,
                           impression_falsifier_met = IMP_falsifier, diagnostic_case = dWE_about_zero & dGE$b > 0))
kt(H2_tab %>% select(b, lo, hi, p, g, g_lo, g_hi, d_fact, d_fact_lo, d_fact_hi, BF10, BFplus0, joint_class, tost_p, description, description_steps2to5_sample, n_steps2to5),
   "H2 step 1: total effect of E on PSR (all cases with PSR; and on the steps 2-5 sample)")
kt(H2_tab %>% select(dW_E, dW_E_lo, dW_E_hi, dW_E_lo90, dW_E_hi90, dW_E_about_zero, dG_E, dG_E_lo, dG_E_hi),
   "H2 step 2: ΔW_E and ΔG_E (core-model coefficients, HC3 CIs)")
kt(H2_boot, glue("H2 steps 2-5: point estimates and within-cell bootstrap 95% CIs ({params$n_boot} resamples, seed 42; percentile)"))
kt(H2_tab %>% select(step4, step5, model_comparison, LR_4b, step4b, LR_4b_steps2to5, impression_falsifier_met, diagnostic_case),
   "H2 steps 4, 4b, 5 and the §0.5 impression-version falsifier")
catg("H2: {H2_desc}. Model comparison (steps 4-5): {H2_closer}. Fixed-prediction comparison (step 4b): {H2_4b} (LR = {f2(LR)}).")
cat("Caveat (§7.2): the slopes are within-cell associations of post-treatment measures; the comparison asks which version's prediction is closer, not whether either mediator causes PSR. G_halo and PSR are reported by the same participant and share method variance, and a positive E effect that W_bar does not capture (for example, expressed enthusiasm) would make the impression version's prediction look closer.\n")
if (!MC_E_pass) cat("MC-E failed: H2 is an estimate for the extraversion instruction, not for perceived extraversion (§8.1).\n")
amb("B01", "§7.2 H2 step 2; §0.5", "The CI type is not stated for 'ΔW_E is described as about zero if its 90% CI lies within ±.07' or for the falsifier's 'ΔG_E, 95% CI above 0': step 2 quantities are core-model coefficients (HC3 under §7.1), but step 3 says that 95% CIs come from the within-cell bootstrap that recomputes every quantity.",
    "HC3 CIs decide; the bootstrap CIs are reported, and a disagreement between the two is printed.", "only if HC3 and bootstrap CIs disagree")
amb("B02", "§7.2 H2 step 4b", "'With b_E and its HC3 standard error SE_E from step 1': step 1 is reported on all cases with PSR and again on the steps 2-5 sample, and step 4b sits inside steps 2-5, whose estimates use that sample.",
    "All cases with PSR (step 1's primary estimate); the steps 2-5 version is reported and a disagreement is printed.", "only if the two samples differ")
save_tab(H2_tab, "H2"); save_tab(H2_boot, "H2_bootstrap")
```

```{r secondary}
})) %>% mutate(q_BH = p.adjust(p, "BH"), finding = q_BH < .05, label = ifelse(finding & BF10 < 3, "weak Bayesian evidence", ""))
```

# 9. Secondary predictions (§8.2-§8.13)

## 9.1 S1 (§8.2)

```{r s1}
tick("S1-U1-M2-M1")
D$Aself_z <- zs(D$tipi_self_agree)
fitS1 <- lm(psr_total ~ A * Aself_z + E, data = D); hS1 <- hc3(fitS1, "A:Aself_z")
V <- vcovHC(fitS1, type = "HC3")
S1_simple <- map_dfr(c(-1, 0, 1), function(z) { b <- coef(fitS1)["A"] + z * coef(fitS1)["A:Aself_z"]
  se <- sqrt(V["A", "A"] + z^2 * V["A:Aself_z", "A:Aself_z"] + 2 * z * V["A", "A:Aself_z"]); q <- qt(.975, df.residual(fitS1))
  tibble(Aself_z = z, b_A = unname(b), lo = unname(b - q * se), hi = unname(b + q * se)) })
hS1r <- hc3(lm(psr_total ~ A * Aself_z + E + E:Aself_z + A:E, data = D), "A:Aself_z")
kt(bind_rows(hS1 %>% mutate(model = "registered"), hS1r %>% mutate(model = "robustness (+E:Aself_z, A:E)")) %>% select(model, b, lo, hi, p), "S1: A x TIPI-Self Agreeableness on PSR (Holm with D2, §8.14)")
kt(S1_simple, "S1: simple effects of A at -1 SD, the mean and +1 SD")
```

## 9.2 U1 (§8.3)

```{r u1}
rel_ok <- function(code) { r <- nlp_rel[nlp_rel$code == code, ]
  nrow(r) == 1 && min(r$mean_pairwise_kappa, r$fleiss_kappa, r$kripp_alpha) >= .60 && r$human_human_kappa >= .60 && r$human_llm_kappa >= .60 }
# Order of events (§8.3): the §7.4 criteria are evaluated (and recorded on OSF) before the U1a correlation is computed
U1a_testable <- rel_ok("emotional_self_disclosure")
U2_testable <- U1a_testable && rel_ok("mirroring_user_emotion")   # §8.12 / §7.4: U2 needs both codes (see log B07)
kt(nlp_rel %>% mutate(meets_7.4 = map_lgl(code, rel_ok)), "§7.4 reliability tiers and human-validation criterion for the U1a/U2 codes")
amb("B07", "§8.3 (order of events); §8.12; §7.4", "§8.3 says that if `emotional_self_disclosure` fails the §7.4 criteria, 'U1a is reported as not testable ... and U2 is tested alone at α = .05', but §8.12 ('Requires both codes') and §7.4 ('emotional_self_disclosure for U1a and U2') make the same code the U2 predictor, so U2 cannot be tested when it fails.",
    "U2 is 'not testable' whenever `emotional_self_disclosure` fails (§8.12, §7.4); the α = .05 fallback is applied to U1a when only `mirroring_user_emotion` fails (§8.3, last sentence).", "only if the disclosure code fails §7.4")
ct <- if (U1a_testable) cor.test(D$phq4_total, D$pct_emotional_self_disclosure) else NULL
# U1b (estimation, no decision; PI decision 18): PHQ-4 coefficient, its BF10, and the indirect effect
fitU1b <- core(D, "psr_total", "phq4_total"); hU <- hc3(fitU1b, "phq4_total")
hUz <- hc3(lm(zs(psr_total) ~ A * E + zs(phq4_total), data = D), "zs(phq4_total)")
dd <- D %>% filter(!is.na(psr_total), !is.na(phq4_total)) %>% transmute(y = psr_total, Af = factor(A), Ef = factor(E), phq = phq4_total)
set.seed(42)
bfU1b <- exp((lmBF(y ~ Af + Ef + Af:Ef + phq, data = dd, rscaleFixed = .5, rscaleCont = "medium", iterations = params$bf_iter, progress = FALSE) /
              lmBF(y ~ Af + Ef + Af:Ef, data = dd, rscaleFixed = .5, iterations = params$bf_iter, progress = FALSE))@bayesFactor$bf)
U1b_ind <- NULL
if (U1a_testable) {
  du <- D %>% transmute(phq = phq4_total, esd = pct_emotional_self_disclosure, psr = psr_total) %>% filter(complete.cases(.))
  u1mod <- "esd ~ a*phq
            psr ~ b*esd + c*phq
            ind := a*b"
  u1fit <- tryCatch(sem(u1mod, data = du, se = "bootstrap", bootstrap = params$lavaan_boot, iseed = 42), error = function(e) { fail("U1b lavaan", conditionMessage(e)); NULL })
  if (!is.null(u1fit)) U1b_ind <- parameterEstimates(u1fit, boot.ci.type = "perc") %>% filter(label %in% c("a", "b", "c", "ind")) %>% select(label, est, ci.lower, ci.upper)
}
U1 <- tibble(U1a_testable = U1a_testable, r = if (U1a_testable) unname(ct$estimate) else NA, r_lo = if (U1a_testable) ct$conf.int[1] else NA,
             r_hi = if (U1a_testable) ct$conf.int[2] else NA, p_U1a = if (U1a_testable) ct$p.value else NA,
             U1b_b_phq = hU$b, U1b_lo = hU$lo, U1b_hi = hU$hi, U1b_beta_std = hUz$b, U1b_beta_lo = hUz$lo, U1b_beta_hi = hUz$hi,
             U1b_BF10 = bfU1b, U1b = "estimate (no decision)",
             U1b_indirect = if (is.null(U1b_ind)) NA else U1b_ind$est[U1b_ind$label == "ind"],
             U1b_indirect_lo = if (is.null(U1b_ind)) NA else U1b_ind$ci.lower[U1b_ind$label == "ind"],
             U1b_indirect_hi = if (is.null(U1b_ind)) NA else U1b_ind$ci.upper[U1b_ind$label == "ind"])
if (U1a_testable) {
  sp <- cor.test(D$phq4_total, D$pct_emotional_self_disclosure, method = "spearman", exact = FALSE)
  # partial r controlling for cell (three dummies) and the number of participant turns (§6.9: role 'user' entries)
  pr <- psych::partial.r(data.frame(phq = D$phq4_total, esd = D$pct_emotional_self_disclosure, c2 = D$cell4 == "highA_lowE",
                                    c3 = D$cell4 == "lowA_highE", c4 = D$cell4 == "lowA_lowE", nturn = D$n_user_turns), 1:2, 3:6)[1, 2]
  U1 <- U1 %>% mutate(spearman = unname(sp$estimate), partial_r_cell_turns = pr)
}
kt(U1 %>% select(-starts_with("U1b")), "U1a (Pearson r; Holm with U2 in notebook section 10 below)")
kt(U1 %>% select(starts_with("U1b")), "U1b: estimates only (PHQ-4 coefficient raw and standardised, BF10, indirect effect via disclosure)")
```

## 9.3 M2: length equivalence (§8.4)

```{r m2}
share_no_usage <- sum(D$n_no_usage, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(D$n_model_replies, na.rm = TRUE)
idx <- if (share_no_usage > .05) "bot_words_per_reply" else "bot_tokens_per_turn"
cm <- D %>% group_by(cell) %>% summarise(m = mean(.data[[idx]], na.rm = TRUE), n = sum(!is.na(.data[[idx]])), no_usage_turns = sum(n_no_usage), .groups = "drop")
GM <- mean(cm$m); bound <- .075 * GM
m2f <- map_dfr(c("A", "E"), function(f) tost_f(D, idx, f, bound, "raw") %>% mutate(factor = f))
cm <- cm %>% mutate(dev_pct = 100 * (m - GM) / GM, within = abs(m - GM) <= bound)
pairs <- combn(cm$cell, 2, simplify = FALSE)
m2pairs <- map_dfr(pairs, function(pp) tost_welch(D[[idx]][D$cell == pp[1]], D[[idx]][D$cell == pp[2]], bound, "raw") %>% mutate(pair = paste(pp, collapse = " vs ")))
M2_dec <- all(m2f$equivalent) & all(cm$within)
kt(cm, glue("M2 cell means of {idx}; unweighted grand mean {f2(GM)}; bound ±{f2(bound)}; {sum(cm$no_usage_turns)} model replies without usage ({f3(share_no_usage)})"))
kt(m2f %>% select(factor, diff, gav, gav_lo90, gav_hi90, p_max, equivalent), "M2 factor-level Welch TOSTs")
kt(m2pairs %>% select(pair, diff, p_max, equivalent), "M2 pairwise cell TOSTs (descriptive)")
cat("M2:", sup(M2_dec), "\n")
m2_secondary <- map_dfr(c("bot_words_per_reply", "first_reply_words", "first_reply_tokens", "mc_length"), function(y)
  map_dfr(c("A", "E"), function(f) bind_cols(tibble(index = y, factor = f), hc3(core(D, y), f) %>% select(b, lo, hi, p))))
kt(m2_secondary, "M2 secondary length indices (not part of the decision)")
wc <- function(s) length(strsplit(trimws(s), "\\s+")[[1]])
kt(D1MAT$table %>% select(cell, S0_words, S1_words) %>%
     mutate(S0_words_recount = map_dbl(cell, ~ wc(MAT$scripts[[.x]][["S0"]])), S1_words_recount = map_dbl(cell, ~ wc(MAT$scripts[[.x]][["S1"]]))),
   "Scripted turns: word counts (fixed; Appendix D.1, and a whitespace recount of the D.1 texts)")
# E2 (§9.5): verbosity mediation, factor -> bot_tokens_per_turn -> PSR, EC, Trust (lavaan, 5,000 bootstrap resamples, iseed = 42).
# It is exploratory, and §8.4 requires it next to H1/H2 if M2 fails.
e2_fit <- function(d) {
  de <- d %>% transmute(tok = bot_tokens_per_turn / 10, psr = psr_total, ec = ec_total, trust = trust_total, A, E, AE = A * E) %>% filter(complete.cases(.))
  mod <- "tok ~ aA*A + aE*E + AE
          psr ~ bP*tok + A + E + AE
          ec ~ bC*tok + A + E + AE
          trust ~ bT*tok + A + E + AE
          A_PSR := aA*bP
          A_EC := aA*bC
          A_Trust := aA*bT
          E_PSR := aE*bP
          E_EC := aE*bC
          E_Trust := aE*bT"
  fit <- tryCatch(sem(mod, data = de, se = "bootstrap", bootstrap = params$lavaan_boot, iseed = 42), error = function(e) { fail("E2 lavaan", conditionMessage(e)); NULL })
  if (is.null(fit)) return(NULL)
  parameterEstimates(fit, boot.ci.type = "perc") %>% filter(op == ":=") %>% transmute(indirect = lhs, est, ci.lower, ci.upper)
}
E2 <- e2_fit(D)
vb <- map_dfr(c(H1 = "A", H2 = "E"), function(f) hc3(core(D %>% filter(!is.na(bot_tokens_per_turn)), "psr_total", c("bot_tokens_per_turn", VC)), f)) %>%
  mutate(estimate = c("H1 verbosity-adjusted b(A)", "H2 verbosity-adjusted b(E)"))
if (!M2_dec) kt(vb %>% select(estimate, b, lo, hi, p), "M2 failed (§8.4): verbosity-adjusted estimates (check 10) reported next to H1/H2; reply length differed by condition")
if (!M2_dec && !is.null(E2)) kt(E2 %>% filter(indirect %in% c("A_PSR", "E_PSR")), "M2 failed (§8.4): E2 indirect effects on PSR via bot tokens per turn (per 10 tokens)")
```
