## 9.5 H4: impression versus placebo adjustment (§8.6)

```{r h4}
tick("H4-H5")
H4_adj <- c(G_halo = "G_halo", MA = "ma_total", MP = "mp_total", ET = "et_total",
            C_ES = "G_c_es", C_O = "G_c_o", ES_O = "G_es_o", ES = "tipi_bot_emostab")
PLAC <- c("MA", "MP", "ET")
# §8.6 sample: complete on PSR, G_halo, Moral Agency, Moral Patiency and Experience-Taking (the composition scores are complete with G_halo)
D4 <- D %>% filter(if_all(c(psr_total, all_of(unname(H4_adj))), ~ !is.na(.x)))
X4 <- cbind(1, D4$A, D4$E, D4$A * D4$E); M4 <- as.matrix(D4[, unname(H4_adj)]); colnames(M4) <- names(H4_adj)
h4_stats <- function(i, fac = 2) {
  Xi <- X4[i, , drop = FALSE]; y <- D4$psr_total[i]; b0 <- ols(Xi, y)[fac]
  badj <- aX <- bX <- setNames(numeric(ncol(M4)), colnames(M4))
  for (k in colnames(M4)) { x <- M4[i, k]; f <- ols(cbind(Xi, x), y); badj[k] <- f[fac]; bX[k] <- f[5]; aX[k] <- ols(Xi, x)[fac] }
  S <- 1 - badj / b0
  c(b_total = b0, setNames(badj, paste0("b_adj_", names(badj))), setNames(S, paste0("S_", names(S))),
    setNames(aX, paste0("a_", names(aX))), setNames(bX, paste0("slope_", names(bX))),
    setNames(badj[PLAC] - badj["G_halo"], paste0("b(.|", PLAC, ") - b(.|G_halo)")),
    setNames(badj["G_halo"] - badj[PLAC], paste0("b(.|G_halo) - b(.|", PLAC, ")")),
    setNames(S["G_halo"] - S[PLAC], paste0("S_G - S_", PLAC)))
}
BI4 <- boot_idx(D4$cell4)
h4_run <- function(fac) {
  est <- h4_stats(seq_len(nrow(D4)), fac); bs <- t(vapply(BI4, h4_stats, numeric(length(est)), fac = fac))
  tibble(stat = names(est), estimate = unname(est), lo = apply(bs, 2, q95)[1, ], hi = apply(bs, 2, q95)[2, ])
}
H4A <- h4_run(2)
h4v <- function(tab, s) tab[tab$stat == s, ]
H4_rule <- dec_H4(h4v(H4A, "S_G_halo")$estimate, h4v(H4A, paste0("b(.|", PLAC, ") - b(.|G_halo)"))$lo, h4v(H4A, paste0("b(.|G_halo) - b(.|", PLAC, ")"))$lo)
H4_dec <- if (H1_dec == "supported") H4_rule else "not testable"      # §8.6, §8.14: evaluated only if H1 is supported
H4_comp <- if (H1_dec == "supported" && h4v(H4A, "S_G_halo")$estimate >= .50 && h4v(H4A, "S_C_O")$estimate < .50)   # label only when H4 is evaluated
  "absorbed mainly by perceived emotional stability, which overlaps in meaning with perceived hostility" else ""
kt(H4A, glue("H4 (warmth): S_X = 1 - b(A|X)/b(A), components a_X and slope_X, and the decision differences (bootstrap 95% CIs). Decision: {H4_dec}",
             "{ifelse(H1_dec == 'supported', '', paste0(' (rule applied descriptively: ', H4_rule, ')'))}"))
if (nchar(H4_comp)) cat("H4 composition (PI decision 15):", H4_comp, "\n")
cat("Interpretation (§8.6): a supported H4 shows that warmth moved the trait impression more than the comparison ratings, while all are associated with PSR within cells; it does not show that the impression, rather than another warmth-related rating, accounts for the effect. Post-treatment adjustment: not mediation.\n")
H4E <- if (startsWith(H2_desc, "positive effect detected")) h4_run(3) else NULL
if (!is.null(H4E)) kt(H4E, "H4 (extraversion): the same statistics for b(E), reported because H2 = positive effect detected")
H4_order <- map_dfr(c("impression_first", "bonding_first"), function(o) {
  k <- which(D4$order == o); BIo <- boot_idx(D4$cell4[k])
  sg <- function(ii) { i <- k[ii]; Xi <- X4[i, , drop = FALSE]; y <- D4$psr_total[i]; 1 - ols(cbind(Xi, D4$G_halo[i]), y)[2] / ols(Xi, y)[2] }
  bs <- map_dbl(BIo, sg)
  tibble(order = o, n = length(k), S_G = sg(seq_along(k)), lo = q95(bs)[1], hi = q95(bs)[2]) })
kt(H4_order, "H4 by measurement order: S_G with bootstrap 95% CIs (no robustness label, §8.6, §8.13)")
save_tab(bind_rows(H4A %>% mutate(factor = "A"), if (!is.null(H4E)) H4E %>% mutate(factor = "E"),
                   H4_order %>% transmute(stat = paste0("S_G_halo [", order, "]"), estimate = S_G, lo, hi, factor = "A")), "H4")
```

## 9.6 H5: halo ratios (§8.7)

```{r h5}
H5_num <- c(A = "tipi_bot_agree", C = "tipi_bot_consc", ES = "tipi_bot_emostab", O = "tipi_bot_open", GE = "G_halo_E", G = "G_halo")
H5_pred <- c(A = .21, C = .20, ES = .27, O = .41, GE = .30, G = .29)
H5_items <- paste0("tipi_bot_", c(4, 5, 9, 10))
D5 <- D %>% filter(if_all(c(tipi_bot_extra, tipi_bot_agree, tipi_bot_consc, tipi_bot_emostab, tipi_bot_open), ~ !is.na(.x)))
X5 <- cbind(1, D5$A, D5$E, D5$A * D5$E)
h5_stats <- function(i, fac = 3, base = "tipi_bot_extra", num = H5_num) {
  Xi <- X5[i, , drop = FALSE]; bE <- ols(Xi, D5[[base]][i])[fac]
  c(setNames(vapply(num, function(v) ols(Xi, D5[[v]][i])[fac] / bE, numeric(1)), paste0("ratio_", names(num))),
    setNames(vapply(H5_items, function(v) ols(Xi, D5[[v]][i])[fac], numeric(1)), paste0("b_E_", H5_items)))
}
H5 <- NULL; H5_dec <- "not testable"     # §8.7, §8.14: computed only if MC-E passes
if (MC_E_pass) {
  BI5 <- boot_idx(D5$cell4); est5 <- h5_stats(seq_len(nrow(D5))); bs5 <- t(vapply(BI5, h5_stats, numeric(length(est5))))
  H5 <- tibble(quantity = names(est5), estimate = unname(est5), lo = apply(bs5, 2, q95)[1, ], hi = apply(bs5, 2, q95)[2, ],
               predicted = c(unname(H5_pred), rep(NA, length(H5_items)))) %>%
    mutate(predicted_in_CI = ifelse(is.na(predicted), NA, lo <= predicted & hi >= predicted),
           role = case_when(quantity == "ratio_GE" ~ "decision (pooled, G_halo_E)",
                            quantity %in% c("ratio_ES", "ratio_O", "ratio_G") ~ "reported: halo or content overlap",
                            TRUE ~ "reported"))
  H5_dec <- sup(H5$lo[H5$quantity == "ratio_GE"] > 0)
  tA <- c(E = "tipi_bot_extra", C = "tipi_bot_consc", ES = "tipi_bot_emostab", O = "tipi_bot_open")
  H5_Afactor <- tibble(trait = names(tA), ratio = unname(h5_stats(seq_len(nrow(D5)), 2, "tipi_bot_agree", tA)[paste0("ratio_", names(tA))]))
  save_tab(H5, "H5")
} else cat("H5 not computed: MC-E failed (precondition, §8.7, §8.14).\n")
if (!is.null(H5)) kt(H5, glue("H5: ratios b_E(TIPI X) / b_E(TIPI Extraversion), pooled ratio with G_halo_E, item-level E effects ({params$n_boot} within-cell bootstrap resamples, 95% CIs). Decision: {H5_dec}"))
if (!is.null(H5)) kt(H5_Afactor, "Exploratory: analogous ratios for the A factor")
if (!is.null(H5)) cat("A positive halo ratio shows spillover between trait ratings; it does not separate a global evaluation from an evaluative or response-style halo (§8.7).\n")
```

## 9.7 D2 and D1: closeness dynamics (§8.8)

```{r d1d2}
tick("D1-D2")
SD_t1 <- pooled_within_sd(D$ios_t1, D$cell4)
fitI1 <- core(D, "ios_t1"); d2 <- hc3(fitI1, "A"); d2E <- hc3(fitI1, "E")
fitPW <- core(D, "psr_total", "W_bar"); bW <- hc3(fitPW, "W_bar")
d2_tost <- tost_coef(fitI1, "A", .40 * SD_t1)                     # §8.8 falsifier: ±0.40 x SD_t1 (PI decision 14), HC3 coefficient TOST
D2_falsifier <- d2_tost$equivalent & bW$b > 0 & bW$p < .05
d1_decide <- function(d) {
  sd1 <- pooled_within_sd(d$ios_t1, d$cell4)
  f <- core(d, "ios_change"); h <- hc3(f, "A"); tt <- tost_coef(f, "A", .30 * sd1)
  sb <- d %>% group_by(cell) %>% summarise(n = n(), share_at_1 = mean(ios_t1 == 1), share_at_7 = mean(ios_t1 == 7), .groups = "drop")
  bound <- any(sb$share_at_1 > .20) || any(sb$share_at_7 > .20)
  list(SD_t1 = sd1, b = h$b, lo = h$lo, hi = h$hi, p = h$p, delta = h$b / sd1, tost_bound = .30 * sd1, tost_p = tt$p_max,
       tost_eq = tt$equivalent, scale_bound = bound, shares = sb, decision = dec_D1(h$b, h$p, tt$equivalent, bound), n = nrow(d))
}
D1 <- d1_decide(D)
D1_interp <- if (startsWith(D1$decision, "first impression")) {
  if (dWA$b >= DW_SCRIPT) "support for a first-impression account (ΔW_A >= ΔW_script)" else
    "the warmth gap did not grow: consistent with a first impression or with free chat that is less differentiated than the scripted opening; not distinguished"
} else if (D1$decision == "narrowing") {
  paste0("the static first-impression account is incomplete in the other direction (§0.5)",
         if (dWA$b < DW_SCRIPT) "; a narrowing gap is also expected if closeness follows free chat that is less differentiated than the scripted opening" else "")
} else if (D1$decision == "accumulation") "a static impression account is incomplete; an accumulation account is needed (§0.5)" else
  if (D1$decision == "not interpretable: scale bound") "neither first impression nor narrowing can be concluded: a floor in the cold cells or a ceiling in the warm cells moves b(A) on the change score downward" else
  "not resolved"
DD12 <- tibble(quantity = c("D2 b(A) on ios_t1", "D2 b(A) in SD_t1 units", "D2 E effect on ios_t1 (estimate)",
                            "D2 falsifier: coefficient TOST, bound ±0.40 x SD_t1 (raw IOS points in 'bound')", "b_W in lm(PSR ~ A * E + W_bar)",
                            "D1 b(A) on ios_change", "D1 delta = b(A) / SD_t1", "D1 coefficient TOST, bound ±0.30 x SD_t1 (raw IOS points)"),
               estimate = c(d2$b, d2$b / SD_t1, d2E$b, d2_tost$b, bW$b, D1$b, D1$delta, D1$b),
               lo = c(d2$lo, d2$lo / SD_t1, d2E$lo, NA, bW$lo, D1$lo, D1$lo / D1$SD_t1, NA),
               hi = c(d2$hi, d2$hi / SD_t1, d2E$hi, NA, bW$hi, D1$hi, D1$hi / D1$SD_t1, NA),
               bound = c(NA, NA, NA, .40 * SD_t1, NA, NA, NA, D1$tost_bound),
               p = c(d2$p, d2$p, d2E$p, d2_tost$p_max, bW$p, D1$p, NA, D1$tost_p))
kt(DD12, glue("D2 / D1 (SD_t1 = {f3(SD_t1)}). D2 falsifier met: {D2_falsifier}. D1: {D1$decision}."))
kt(D1$shares %>% mutate(flag_floor = share_at_1 > .20, flag_ceiling = share_at_7 > .20), glue("D1 scale-bound rule at probe 1 (per bound, any cell > 20%): triggered = {D1$scale_bound}"))
catg("D1 interpretation: {D1_interp}. ΔW_script = {f3(DW_SCRIPT)}, ΔW_A = {f3(dWA$b)}.")
if (startsWith(D1$decision, "first impression") || D1$decision == "narrowing")
  cat("Limitation (§8.8): the identical item is answered three times, so earlier answers may anchor later ones.\n")
if (D2_falsifier) cat("D2 falsifier met: tone in the user-independent opening does not move closeness, but co-produced tone does; counts against the tone version (§0.5).\n")
cat("What D2 can show (§8.8): effects of 'the warm and cold scripted openings'; not that tone, rather than other content of these texts, is responsible.\n")
# Trajectory (reported with D1) and the ordinal::clmm analysis (§8.8; required when the scale-bound rule is triggered)
long <- D %>% select(session_uuid, A, E, ios_t1, ios_t2, ios_t3, ios_t1_elapsed, ios_t2_elapsed, ios_t3_elapsed) %>%
  pivot_longer(c(ios_t1, ios_t2, ios_t3), names_to = "probe", values_to = "ios") %>%
  mutate(time = c(ios_t1 = 0, ios_t2 = .5, ios_t3 = 1)[probe],
         elapsed = case_when(probe == "ios_t1" ~ ios_t1_elapsed, probe == "ios_t2" ~ ios_t2_elapsed, TRUE ~ ios_t3_elapsed) / 600) %>%
  filter(!is.na(ios))
traj <- lmer(ios ~ A * E * time + (1 | session_uuid), data = long)
traj2 <- lmer(ios ~ A * E * elapsed + (1 | session_uuid), data = long)
gapA <- function(fit, tv) { b <- fixef(fit); V <- as.matrix(vcov(fit)); nm <- names(b); tn <- nm[grepl("^A:(time|elapsed)$", nm)]
  map_dfr(tv, function(t) { L <- setNames(rep(0, length(b)), nm); L["A"] <- 1; L[tn] <- t; est <- sum(L * b); se <- sqrt(drop(t(L) %*% V %*% L))
    tibble(time = t, A_gap = est, lo = est - 1.96 * se, hi = est + 1.96 * se) }) }
kt(bind_rows(gapA(traj, c(0, .5, 1)) %>% mutate(model = "lmer, time = 0/.5/1"), gapA(traj2, c(11/600, .5, 1)) %>% mutate(model = "lmer, time = active seconds / 600")),
   "Trajectory: model-implied warmth gap in IOS at each probe")
lc <- long %>% transmute(ios = factor(ios, ordered = TRUE), A, E, time = elapsed, pid = factor(session_uuid)) %>% as.data.frame()
t_clmm <- Sys.time()
clmm_fit <- tryCatch(ordinal::clmm(ios ~ A * E * time + (1 | pid), data = lc), error = function(e) { fail("D1 clmm", conditionMessage(e)); NULL })
t_clmm <- as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), t_clmm, units = "secs"))
CLMM <- if (is.null(clmm_fit)) NULL else { cs <- summary(clmm_fit)$coefficients
  tibble(term = "A:time", estimate = cs["A:time", "Estimate"], se = cs["A:time", "Std. Error"], p = cs["A:time", "Pr(>|z|)"],
         sign = ifelse(cs["A:time", "Estimate"] > 0, "+", "-"), required = D1$scale_bound) }
if (!is.null(CLMM)) kt(CLMM, glue("ordinal::clmm(ios ~ A * E * time + (1 | participant)), time = ios_tK_elapsed / 600: sign and p of A:time ",
                                  "({ifelse(D1$scale_bound, 'required: scale bound triggered', 'reported; required only when the scale bound is triggered')}; {round(t_clmm)} s)"))
ceil <- D %>% select(cell, ios_t1, ios_t2, ios_t3) %>% pivot_longer(-cell) %>% filter(!is.na(value)) %>% group_by(cell, name) %>%
  summarise(p_at_7 = mean(value == 7), p_at_1 = mean(value == 1), .groups = "drop") %>% mutate(flag = p_at_7 > .20 | p_at_1 > .20)
kt(ceil, "IOS floor/ceiling by probe and cell (flag > 20%)")
catg("r(ios_t3, PSR) = {f3(cor(D$ios_t3, D$psr_total))} (convergent validity, expected >= .50); probe 2 not triggered for {sum(D$ios_t2_status == 'not_triggered')} participants. ",
         "Limitation: all participants answer the probes, so probe reactivity cannot be estimated.")
save_tab(DD12 %>% mutate(D1_decision = D1$decision, D1_scale_bound = D1$scale_bound, D2_falsifier = D2_falsifier), "D1_D2")
```

## 9.8 R1, R3, R4, R5: the responsibility template (§8.9)

```{r r1}
tick("R1-R6")
R1c <- D %>% group_by(cell) %>% group_modify(~ {
  bind_cols(tibble(m_company = mean(.x$liab_1), m_sylva = mean(.x$liab_6), m_user = mean(.x$liab_9)),
            paired_ci(.x$liab_1, .x$liab_6) %>% rename_with(~ paste0("cs_", .x)),
            paired_ci(.x$liab_9, .x$liab_1) %>% rename_with(~ paste0("uc_", .x))) }) %>% ungroup() %>%
  mutate(sylva_lowest = m_sylva < pmin(m_company, m_user), cs_above0 = cs_lo > 0, sylva_above_company = m_sylva > m_company & cs_hi < 0)
uc_pool <- paired_ci(D$liab_9, D$liab_1); cs_pool <- paired_ci(D$liab_1, D$liab_6)
dz_se <- sqrt(1 / cs_pool$n + cs_pool$dz^2 / (2 * cs_pool$n))      # §8.9: normal approximation
R1_dec <- if (any(R1c$sylva_above_company)) "contradicted" else
  if (all(R1c$sylva_lowest & R1c$cs_above0) && uc_pool$lo > -.40) "supported" else "inconclusive"
kt(R1c %>% select(cell, m_company, m_sylva, m_user, cs_diff, cs_lo, cs_hi, uc_diff, uc_lo, sylva_lowest, cs_above0, sylva_above_company), glue("R1 by cell. Decision: {R1_dec}"))
kt(tibble(contrast = c("company - Sylva (pooled)", "user - company (pooled)"), diff = c(cs_pool$diff, uc_pool$diff), lo = c(cs_pool$lo, uc_pool$lo),
          hi = c(cs_pool$hi, uc_pool$hi), dz = c(cs_pool$dz, uc_pool$dz), dz_lo = c(cs_pool$dz - 1.96 * dz_se, NA), dz_hi = c(cs_pool$dz + 1.96 * dz_se, NA)),
   "R1 pooled contrasts (point predictions: company - Sylva >= .80 raw, dz >= .60; not part of the decision)")
```

```{r r3}
seg_gate <- function(y, x, Xc) {
  # §8.9 gate test: one-breakpoint model by grid search over the 10th-90th percentiles of x (81 candidates); BIC with
  # k_linear + 2 parameters (breakpoint and slope change); BF10 = exp((BIC_linear - BIC_segmented) / 2)
  lin <- lm(y ~ x + Xc); grid <- quantile(x, seq(.10, .90, by = .01), names = FALSE)
  rss <- map_dbl(grid, ~ sum(resid(lm(y ~ x + pmax(x - .x, 0) + Xc))^2))
  n <- length(y); k_lin <- length(coef(lin)) + 1
  bic_lin <- BIC(lin); bic_seg <- n * log(min(rss) / n) + n * (1 + log(2 * pi)) + (k_lin + 2) * log(n)
  stopifnot(length(grid) == 81, abs(bic_lin - (n * log(sum(resid(lin)^2) / n) + n * (1 + log(2 * pi)) + k_lin * log(n))) < 1e-6)
  tibble(breakpoint = grid[which.min(rss)], BIC_linear = bic_lin, BIC_segmented = bic_seg, BF10_breakpoint = exp((bic_lin - bic_seg) / 2))
}
r3_fit <- function(yvar, xvar, label) {
  dd <- D %>% filter(!is.na(.data[[yvar]]), !is.na(.data[[xvar]])) %>% mutate(zy = zs(.data[[yvar]]), zx = zs(.data[[xvar]]))
  fit <- lm(zy ~ zx + A + E + A:E, data = dd); h90 <- hc3(fit, "zx", .90); h95 <- hc3(fit, "zx", .95)
  sg <- seg_gate(dd$zy, dd$zx, cbind(dd$A, dd$E, dd$A * dd$E))
  tibble(model = label, outcome = yvar, predictor = xvar, n = nrow(dd), beta = h95$b, lo90 = h90$lo, hi90 = h90$hi, lo95 = h95$lo, hi95 = h95$hi) %>%
    bind_cols(sg) %>% mutate(rule = dec_R3(hi90, lo95, BF10_breakpoint))
}
R3 <- bind_rows(r3_fit("liab_6", "ma_cap", "registered (PI decision 12)"),
                r3_fit("liab_chat", "ma_cap", "robustness: Chatbot Responsibility composite"),
                r3_fit("liab_6", "ma_total", "robustness: 8-item Moral Agency"),
                r3_fit("liab_chat", "ma_total", "robustness: both composites (revision-2 specification)"),
                r3_fit("v2_resp_sylva", "ma_cap", "report: vignette 2 (v2_resp_sylva)"))
R3_dec <- R3$rule[1]
kt(R3, glue("R3: standardised beta of perceived agency (HC3 CIs) and the grid-search breakpoint gate. Decision (registered row): {R3_dec}"))
save_tab(R3, "R3")
```

```{r r4}
r4_bf <- function(y, ma) {
  dd4 <- D %>% transmute(y = zs(.data[[y]]), Af = factor(A), Ef = factor(E), ma = zs(.data[[ma]]), mp = zs(mp_total), psr = zs(psr_total),
                         ec = zs(ec_total), tr = zs(trust_total)) %>% filter(complete.cases(.))
  set.seed(42)
  exp((lmBF(y ~ Af + Ef + Af:Ef + ma + mp + psr + ec + tr, data = dd4, rscaleFixed = .5, rscaleCont = "medium", iterations = params$bf_iter, progress = FALSE) /
       lmBF(y ~ Af + Ef + Af:Ef + ma + mp, data = dd4, rscaleFixed = .5, rscaleCont = "medium", iterations = params$bf_iter, progress = FALSE))@bayesFactor$bf)
}
bfR4 <- r4_bf("liab_6", "ma_cap")
# Decision model (§8.9): lm(z(liab_6) ~ A * E + z(ma_cap) + z(MP) + B), B = bonding composite (§6.15)
fitB <- lm(zs(liab_6) ~ A * E + zs(ma_cap) + zs(mp_total) + B, data = D); beta_B <- unname(coef(fitB)["B"]); hB <- hc3(fitB, "B")
fit4 <- lm(zs(liab_6) ~ A * E + zs(ma_cap) + zs(mp_total) + zs(psr_total) + zs(ec_total) + zs(trust_total), data = D)
R4_dec <- dec_R4(bfR4, beta_B)
kt(tibble(BF10 = bfR4, BF01 = 1 / bfR4, beta_B = beta_B, beta_B_lo = hB$lo, beta_B_hi = hB$hi,
          beta_PSR = unname(coef(fit4)["zs(psr_total)"]), beta_EC = unname(coef(fit4)["zs(ec_total)"]), beta_Trust = unname(coef(fit4)["zs(trust_total)"]),
          decision = R4_dec),
   "R4: BF for adding PSR, EC and Trust to ma_cap + patiency (outcome liab_6); bonding-composite coefficient (decision); separate coefficients reported")
bfR4c <- r4_bf("liab_chat", "ma_total")
fit4c <- lm(zs(liab_chat) ~ A * E + zs(ma_total) + zs(mp_total) + B, data = D)
kt(tibble(model = "robustness: Chatbot Responsibility composite and 8-item Moral Agency", BF10 = bfR4c, BF01 = 1 / bfR4c, beta_B = unname(coef(fit4c)["B"])),
   "R4 robustness with the composites (PI decision 12: reported, not the decision)")
amb("B03", "§8.9 R4 (and §0.5 (ii))", "'Supported if BF01 > 3; contradicted if BF10 > 3 or if the standardized coefficient of the bonding composite B ... is ≥ .25': a result with BF01 > 3 and beta_B ≥ .25 meets both the supported and the contradicted condition, and no precedence is stated. (R3's two conditions can overlap only if SE(beta) < .028, which N = 272 cannot give.)",
    "'Contradicted' takes precedence (§0.5 lists beta_B ≥ .25 as counting against the account).", "only in the overlap case")
# Path model PSR -> ma_cap -> liab_6 with A, E, A:E as fixed covariates (lavaan sem, ML, fixed.x = TRUE, 5,000 bootstrap, iseed 42, percentile)
dl <- D %>% transmute(psr = zs(psr_total), ma = zs(ma_cap), y6 = zs(liab_6), A, E, AE = A * E) %>% filter(complete.cases(.))
mod <- "ma ~ a*psr + A + E + AE
        y6 ~ b*ma + c*psr + A + E + AE
        ind := a*b"
t_lav <- Sys.time()
semfit <- tryCatch(sem(mod, data = dl, estimator = "ML", fixed.x = TRUE, se = "bootstrap", bootstrap = params$lavaan_boot, iseed = 42),
                   error = function(e) { fail("R4 lavaan", conditionMessage(e)); NULL })
t_lav <- as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), t_lav, units = "secs"))
if (!is.null(semfit)) {
  pe <- parameterEstimates(semfit, boot.ci.type = "perc", standardized = TRUE) %>% filter(label %in% c("a", "b", "c", "ind"))
  kt(pe %>% select(label, est, ci.lower, ci.upper, std.all), glue("R4 path model on z-scored PSR, ma_cap, liab_6 (lavaan, {params$lavaan_boot} bootstrap resamples; {round(t_lav)} s). Predictions: a = .4-.5; ind about 0. Associations, not causal estimates."))
}
```


## 9.9 R2c, R2d (§8.10)

```{r r2cd}
R2c_main <- SECF %>% filter(var %in% c("liab_chat", "liab_user", "liab_harm")) %>% transmute(test = paste(outcome, factor), BF10)
R2d_main <- map_dfr(c("v2_company", "v2_sylva", "v2_user", "gap_v2"), function(y) map_dfr(c("A", "E"), function(f)
  tibble(test = paste(y, f), BF10 = bf_reg(D, y, f))))
R2c_dec <- dec_R2cd(R2c_main$BF10); R2d_dec <- dec_R2cd(R2d_main$BF10)
R2CD <- bind_rows(R2c_main %>% mutate(set = "R2c"), R2d_main %>% mutate(set = "R2d")) %>% mutate(BF01 = 1 / BF10, BF01_gt3 = BF01 > 3, BF10_gt3 = BF10 > 3)
kt(R2CD, glue("R2c: {sum(R2c_main$BF10 > 3)} of 6 BF10 > 3, {sum(1 / R2c_main$BF10 > 3)} of 6 BF01 > 3 -> {R2c_dec}. ",
              "R2d: {sum(R2d_main$BF10 > 3)} of 8 BF10 > 3, {sum(1 / R2d_main$BF10 > 3)} of 8 BF01 > 3 -> {R2d_dec}"))
# Profile test (descriptive; not part of the decision): 12 items in long format, item:A and item:E, participant random
lp <- D %>% select(session_uuid, A, E, all_of(paste0("liab_", 1:12))) %>% pivot_longer(starts_with("liab_"), names_to = "item", values_to = "y") %>%
  mutate(item = factor(item), Af = factor(A), Ef = factor(E), pid = factor(session_uuid)) %>% as.data.frame()
t_prof <- Sys.time(); set.seed(42)
bf_prof <- tryCatch(exp((lmBF(y ~ item + Af + Ef + Af:Ef + item:Af + item:Ef + pid, data = lp, whichRandom = "pid", rscaleFixed = .5,
                               iterations = params$profile_bf_iter, progress = FALSE) /
                         lmBF(y ~ item + Af + Ef + Af:Ef + pid, data = lp, whichRandom = "pid", rscaleFixed = .5,
                               iterations = params$profile_bf_iter, progress = FALSE))@bayesFactor$bf),
                    error = function(e) { fail("R2c profile lmBF", conditionMessage(e)); NA_real_ })
t_prof <- as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), t_prof, units = "secs"))
catg("Profile BF01 (reduced over full; descriptive, not evidence of absence, §8.10) = {fbf(1 / bf_prof)} ({params$profile_bf_iter} iterations, {round(t_prof)} s).")
item_g <- map_dfr(paste0("liab_", 1:12), function(it) map_dfr(c("A", "E"), function(f) g_marg(D, it, f, .90) %>% mutate(item = it, factor = f)))
kt(item_g %>% relocate(item, factor), "R2c: Hedges's g (90% CI) for the A and E effect on each of the 12 vignette-1 items")
save_tab(bind_rows(R2CD, tibble(test = "12-item profile (item:A, item:E), descriptive", BF10 = bf_prof, set = "R2c profile", BF01 = 1 / bf_prof)), "R2c_R2d")
```

## 9.10 R6 (§8.11)

```{r r6}
vt <- t.test(D$v2_cause_sylva, mu = 3)                              # vignette check first: one-sample t against 3, two-sided, positive sign
vchk_ok <- mean(D$v2_cause_sylva) > 3 & vt$p.value < .05
g95 <- paired_ci(D$v2_resp_company, D$v2_resp_sylva, .95)
R6a <- if (!vchk_ok) "not interpretable" else dec_R6a(g95$lo, g95$hi)
sev90 <- paired_ci(D$v2_severity, D$liab_11, .90); sev_comparable <- sev90$lo > -.40 & sev90$hi < .40
disc_m <- map_dfr(c(company = "disc_company", Sylva = "disc_sylva", user = "disc_user"), function(v) { t <- t.test(D[[v]])
  tibble(estimate = mean(D[[v]]), lo = t$conf.int[1], hi = t$conf.int[2]) }, .id = "party")
R6tab <- bind_rows(
  tibble(test = "vignette check: mean v2_cause_sylva vs 3 (one-sample t)", diff = mean(D$v2_cause_sylva) - 3, lo = vt$conf.int[1] - 3, hi = vt$conf.int[2] - 3, p = vt$p.value),
  paired_ci(D$v2_cause_sylva, D$liab_7) %>% mutate(test = "descriptive: v2_cause_sylva - liab_7 (different wordings and vignettes)"),
  paired_ci(D$v2_cause_sylva, D$v2_cause_company) %>% mutate(test = "descriptive: v2_cause_sylva - v2_cause_company"),
  g95 %>% mutate(test = "R6a: gap_v2 = v2_resp_company - v2_resp_sylva (95% CI)"),
  paired_ci(D$disc_sylva, D$disc_user) %>% mutate(test = "R6b (exploratory): discount Sylva - user ('adviser versus actor')"),
  paired_ci(D$v2_oblig_sylva, D$v2_oblig_user) %>% mutate(test = "standing index: v2_oblig_sylva - v2_oblig_user"),
  paired_ci(D$v2_oblig_sylva, D$v2_oblig_company) %>% mutate(test = "standing index: v2_oblig_sylva - v2_oblig_company"),
  sev90 %>% mutate(test = "severity: v2_severity - liab_11 (90% CI; comparable if within ±0.40)"),
  paired_ci(D$liab_1, D$liab_6) %>% mutate(test = "gap_v1 = liab_1 - liab_6"),
  paired_ci(D$gap_v1, D$gap_v2) %>% mutate(test = "gap_v1 - gap_v2 (paired)")) %>% relocate(test)
kt(R6tab, glue("R6. Vignette check passed: {vchk_ok}. R6a: {R6a}."))
kt(disc_m, "R6b (exploratory): conversion discount (cause - responsibility) by party, 95% CI")
cat(if (sev_comparable) "The two vignettes are described as comparably severe (§8.11)." else
    glue("Severity differed between the vignettes; gap_v1 - gap_v2 = {f2(mean(D$gap_v1 - D$gap_v2))} is reported with that statement and is not attributed to who caused the harm."), "\n")
cat("Stated with every R6 result (§8.11): vignette 2 always follows vignette 1 and the open-ended responsibility questions, so the change mixes vignette content with position and with having already judged vignette 1. A company-primary result is also predicted if participants hold a creator responsible for its agent or an adviser less responsible than the person who acted; Study 3 cannot show that Sylva lacks standing.\n")
R1v2 <- D %>% group_by(cell) %>% group_modify(~ bind_cols(paired_ci(.x$v2_resp_company, .x$v2_resp_sylva) %>% rename_with(~ paste0("cs_", .x)),
                                                           paired_ci(.x$v2_resp_user, .x$v2_resp_company) %>% rename_with(~ paste0("uc_", .x)))) %>% ungroup()
kt(R1v2 %>% select(cell, cs_diff, cs_lo, cs_hi, uc_diff, uc_lo, uc_hi), "R1 contrasts for vignette 2, by cell (reported with R6)")
```

## 9.11 U2 (§8.12)

```{r u2}
tick("U2-O1")
if (U2_testable) {
  mr <- D %>% select(session_uuid, incl_rounds) %>% unnest_longer(incl_rounds, values_to = "round")
  # participant turn at round r >= 2 paired with the model-generated reply of round r (§6.9 set); failed requests have no reply and drop out
  ut <- nlp_turns %>% filter(role == "user", round >= 2) %>% select(session_uuid, round, disclosure = emotional_self_disclosure) %>%
    inner_join(nlp_turns %>% filter(role == "assistant") %>% select(session_uuid, round, mirror = mirroring_user_emotion) %>%
                 semi_join(mr, by = c("session_uuid", "round")), by = c("session_uuid", "round")) %>%
    inner_join(D %>% select(session_uuid, A, E, cell), by = "session_uuid") %>%
    group_by(session_uuid) %>% mutate(disc_pm = mean(disclosure), disc_w = disclosure - disc_pm) %>% ungroup()
  fitU2s <- glmer(mirror ~ disc_w * A * E + disc_pm + (1 + disc_w | session_uuid), data = ut, family = binomial)
  conv_msgs <- fitU2s@optinfo$conv$lme4$messages
  U2_nonconv <- length(conv_msgs) > 0                                # §8.12: non-convergence = an lme4 convergence message
  fitU2 <- if (U2_nonconv) glmer(mirror ~ disc_w * A * E + disc_pm + (1 | session_uuid), data = ut, family = binomial) else fitU2s
  u2_or <- function(fit) {
    b <- fixef(fit); Vu <- as.matrix(vcov(fit)); z <- unname(b["disc_w"] / sqrt(Vu["disc_w", "disc_w"]))
    cells <- map_dfr(list(c(.5, .5), c(.5, -.5), c(-.5, .5), c(-.5, -.5)), function(ae) {
      L <- setNames(rep(0, length(b)), names(b)); L["disc_w"] <- 1; L["disc_w:A"] <- ae[1]; L["disc_w:E"] <- ae[2]; L["disc_w:A:E"] <- ae[1] * ae[2]
      est <- sum(L * b); se <- sqrt(drop(t(L) %*% Vu %*% L)); tibble(A = ae[1], E = ae[2], OR = exp(est), lo = exp(est - 1.96 * se), hi = exp(est + 1.96 * se)) })
    list(OR = unname(exp(b["disc_w"])), p = unname(2 * pnorm(-abs(z))), cells = cells)
  }
  U2r <- u2_or(fitU2); OR_U2 <- U2r$OR; p_U2 <- U2r$p; cellOR <- U2r$cells
  U2_overall <- tibble(turn_pairs = nrow(ut), participants = n_distinct(ut$session_uuid),
                       model_of_record = ifelse(U2_nonconv, "random intercept (random-slope fit returned a convergence message)", "random slope"),
                       OR = OR_U2, p = p_U2, singular = isSingular(fitU2), convergence_messages = paste(conv_msgs, collapse = "; "))
  U2_sens <- if (U2_nonconv) { s <- u2_or(fitU2s); s$cells %>% mutate(OR_overall = s$OR, p_overall = s$p) } else NULL
} else { p_U2 <- NA_real_; OR_U2 <- NA_real_; cellOR <- NULL; U2_sens <- NULL; cat("U2 not testable: a code fails §7.4.\n") }
if (U2_testable) kt(U2_overall, "U2: overall odds ratio for within-person disclosure (disc_w), at A = E = 0 (model of record)")
if (U2_testable) kt(cellOR, "U2: cell-specific odds ratios (model of record)")
if (!is.null(U2_sens)) kt(U2_sens, "U2 sensitivity analysis: the random-slope model (lme4 returned a convergence message)")
```

## 9.12 O1: order check (§8.13)

```{r o1}
fitO <- lm(psr_total ~ A * E + O + A:O + E:O, data = D)
o_tost <- tost_welch(D$psr_total[D$O > 0], D$psr_total[D$O < 0], BOUND_PSR, "raw")
hAO <- hc3(fitO, "A:O"); hEO <- hc3(fitO, "E:O"); sO <- sigma(fitO)
O1_dec <- sup(o_tost$equivalent)
fitOG <- lm(psr_total ~ A * E + G_halo * O, data = D); hGO <- hc3(fitOG, "G_halo:O")
O1_tab <- bind_rows(tibble(term = "order main effect: Welch TOST, raw bounds ±0.39 PSR units", b = o_tost$diff, lo = o_tost$diff_lo90, hi = o_tost$diff_hi90, p = o_tost$p_max),
                    hAO %>% select(term, b, lo, hi, p) %>% mutate(term = "A:O (raw)"),
                    tibble(term = "A:O in d units (/ sqrt(MSE) of the O1 model)", b = hAO$b / sO, lo = hAO$lo / sO, hi = hAO$hi / sO, p = hAO$p),
                    hEO %>% select(term, b, lo, hi, p) %>% mutate(term = "E:O (raw)"),
                    hGO %>% select(term, b, lo, hi, p) %>% mutate(term = "G_halo:O in lm(PSR ~ A * E + G_halo * O)"))
kt(O1_tab, glue("O1. Decision: {O1_dec}{ifelse(o_tost$equivalent, ' (PSR does not differ by order by as much as ±0.39 PSR units)', '')}"))
cat(if (hAO$p < .05) "A:O p < .05: the warmth effect is reported within each order, and the abstract says so; the H1 decision is unchanged.\n" else
    "No A x order interaction detected; not resolved at this N (power .38 to detect a difference of d = 0.40 between the orders' warmth effects).\n")
if (hAO$p < .05) kt(map_dfr(c("impression_first", "bonding_first"), ~ hc3(core(D[D$order == .x, ], "psr_total"), "A") %>% mutate(order = .x)), "Warmth effect within each order")
o_other <- map_dfr(c("G_halo", "tipi_bot_agree", "tipi_bot_extra", "mc_agreeableness", "mc_extraversion", "mc_neuroticism", "mc_e_energetic", "mc_length"),
                   function(y) hc3(lm(reformulate(c("A", "E", "A:E", "O"), y), data = D), "O") %>% mutate(outcome = y))
kt(o_other %>% select(outcome, b, lo, hi, p), "Order effects on G_halo, TIPI-Bot Agreeableness and Extraversion, and the manipulation checks; H4 by order is in section 9.5")
amb("B04", "§8.13 O1", "'A × order is reported with its 95% CI in d units' does not name the standardiser.",
    "A:O coefficient / sqrt(MSE) of the O1 model, by analogy with H3 (§2.3); the raw coefficient is shown as well.", "no (report only)")
```

# 10. Multiplicity (§8.14), the prediction table (§11.1) and the account summary (§0.5, §0.6)

```{r multiplicity}
p_holm1 <- p.adjust(c(S1 = unname(hS1$p), D2 = unname(d2$p)), "holm")
# §8.3: if one of U1a / U2 is not testable, the other is tested alone at alpha = .05
p_holm2 <- if (U1a_testable && U2_testable) p.adjust(c(U1a = unname(ct$p.value), U2 = unname(p_U2)), "holm") else
  c(U1a = if (U1a_testable) unname(ct$p.value) else NA_real_, U2 = if (U2_testable) unname(p_U2) else NA_real_)
S1_dec <- sup(hS1$b > 0 && p_holm1[["S1"]] < .05)
D2_dec <- sup(d2$b > 0 && p_holm1[["D2"]] < .05)
U1a_dec <- if (!U1a_testable) "not testable" else sup(unname(ct$estimate) > 0 && p_holm2[["U1a"]] < .05)
U2_dec <- if (!U2_testable) "not testable" else sup(OR_U2 > 1 && p_holm2[["U2"]] < .05 && all(cellOR$lo > 1))
kt(tibble(family = c("{S1, D2}", "{S1, D2}", "{U1a, U2}", "{U1a, U2}"), test = c("S1", "D2", "U1a", "U2"),
          p = c(hS1$p, d2$p, if (U1a_testable) ct$p.value else NA, p_U2), p_holm = c(p_holm1[["S1"]], p_holm1[["D2"]], p_holm2[["U1a"]], p_holm2[["U2"]])),
   "Holm families (§8.14)")
r2r <- function(h) { r <- R2[R2$hyp == h, ]; glue("{r$label}; TOST p = {fp(r$tost_raw_p)}, Welch p = {fp(r$welch_p)}, diff = {f3(r$diff)}, BF10 = {fbf(r$BF10)}") }
PRED <- tribble(~id, ~status, ~registered_test, ~result, ~decision,
  "H1", "primary", "§7.2: HC3 b(A) on PSR, two-sided .05", glue("b = {f3(h1$b)} [{f3(h1$lo)}, {f3(h1$hi)}], p = {fp(h1$p)}, g = {f2(g1$g)}, BF10 = {fbf(bf1)}; joint class: {H1_tab$joint_class}; strict joint criterion met: {H1_strict}"), H1_dec,
  "R2a", "primary", "§7.2: Welch TOST ±0.40 on Corporate Liability (A)", r2r("R2a"), R2$decision[R2$hyp == "R2a"],
  "R2b", "primary", "§7.2: Welch TOST ±0.40 on Corporate Liability (E)", r2r("R2b"), R2$decision[R2$hyp == "R2b"],
  "H2", "estimation", "§7.2 steps 1-5 (no pass/fail)", glue("b(E) = {f3(h2$b)} [{f3(h2$lo)}, {f3(h2$hi)}], TOST ±0.39 p = {fp(tost2$p_max)}; D [{f3(qb('D')$lo)}, {f3(qb('D')$hi)}], D_step5 [{f3(qb('D_step5')$lo)}, {f3(qb('D_step5')$hi)}]; LR(4b) = {f2(LR)}"),
    glue("{H2_desc} | steps 4-5: {H2_closer} | step 4b: {H2_4b}"),
  "H3", "estimation", "§7.2: A:E on PSR (no pass/fail)", glue("b(A:E) = {f3(hAE$b)} [{f3(hAE$lo)}, {f3(hAE$hi)}], p = {fp(hAE$p)}"), H3_tab$statement,
  "MC-A", "check", "§8.1: b(A) on TIPI-Bot A > 0, p < .05", glue("b = {f3(mc_primary$b[1])}, p = {fp(mc_primary$p[1])}"), pass(MC_A_pass),
  "MC-E", "check", "§8.1: b(E) on TIPI-Bot E > 0, p < .05", glue("b = {f3(mc_primary$b[2])}, p = {fp(mc_primary$p[2])}"), pass(MC_E_pass),
  "M1", "secondary", "§8.5: b(A) on W_bar > 0, p < .05", glue("ΔW_A = {f3(dWA$b)}, p = {fp(dWA$p)}; ΔW_E = {f3(hc3(fitW, 'E')$b)}"), pass(M1_pass),
  "M2", "secondary", "§8.4: factor TOSTs ±7.5% and every cell within ±7.5%", glue("TOST p (A, E) = {fp(m2f$p_max[1])}, {fp(m2f$p_max[2])}; cell deviations {paste(sprintf('%+.1f%%', cm$dev_pct), collapse = ', ')}"), sup(M2_dec),
  "H4", "secondary", "§8.6: S_G >= .50 and b(A|P) - b(A|G_halo) CIs above 0", glue("S_G = {f2(h4v(H4A, 'S_G_halo')$estimate)}; S_C+O = {f2(h4v(H4A, 'S_C_O')$estimate)}{ifelse(nchar(H4_comp), paste0('; ', H4_comp), '')}{ifelse(H1_dec == 'supported', '', paste0('; precondition (H1 supported) not met; rule applied descriptively: ', H4_rule))}"), H4_dec,
  "H5", "secondary", "§8.7: pooled ratio (G_halo_E) bootstrap 95% CI above 0", if (is.null(H5)) "precondition (MC-E passes) not met" else
    glue("ratio_GE = {f2(H5$estimate[H5$quantity == 'ratio_GE'])} [{f2(H5$lo[H5$quantity == 'ratio_GE'])}, {f2(H5$hi[H5$quantity == 'ratio_GE'])}]"), H5_dec,
  "D1", "secondary", "§8.8: b(A) on ios_change, TOST ±0.30 SD_t1, scale bound", glue("delta = {f3(D1$delta)}, p = {fp(D1$p)}, TOST p = {fp(D1$tost_p)}, scale bound triggered: {D1$scale_bound}; {D1_interp}"), D1$decision,
  "D2", "secondary", "§8.8: b(A) on ios_t1 > 0, Holm with S1", glue("b = {f3(d2$b)}, Holm p = {fp(p_holm1[['D2']])}; falsifier (±0.40 SD TOST and b_W > 0) met: {D2_falsifier}"), D2_dec,
  "S1", "secondary", "§8.2: A x Aself_z > 0, Holm with D2", glue("b = {f3(hS1$b)}, Holm p = {fp(p_holm1[['S1']])}"), S1_dec,
  "R1", "secondary", "§8.9: Sylva lowest, company - Sylva CI > 0 in every cell; user - company LB > -0.40", glue("pooled company - Sylva = {f2(cs_pool$diff)} (dz = {f2(cs_pool$dz)}); user - company LB = {f2(uc_pool$lo)}"), R1_dec,
  "R2c", "secondary", "§8.10: 6 main-effect BFs", glue("{sum(R2c_main$BF10 > 3)} BF10 > 3; {sum(1 / R2c_main$BF10 > 3)} of 6 BF01 > 3 (need >= 4)"), R2c_dec,
  "R2d", "secondary", "§8.10: 8 main-effect BFs", glue("{sum(R2d_main$BF10 > 3)} BF10 > 3; {sum(1 / R2d_main$BF10 > 3)} of 8 BF01 > 3 (need >= 5)"), R2d_dec,
  "R3", "secondary", "§8.9: beta of ma_cap on liab_6; breakpoint gate", glue("beta = {f3(R3$beta[1])}, 90% UB = {f3(R3$hi90[1])}, 95% LB = {f3(R3$lo95[1])}, breakpoint BF10 = {fbf(R3$BF10_breakpoint[1])}"), R3_dec,
  "R4", "secondary", "§8.9: BF for PSR, EC, Trust; bonding-composite coefficient", glue("BF01 = {fbf(1 / bfR4)}; beta_B = {f3(beta_B)}"), R4_dec,
  "R5", "secondary", "§8.9: r(company, Sylva) LB > .30; user correlations within ±.25", glue("r(company, Sylva) = {f2(R5$r[1])} [{f2(R5$lo[1])}, {f2(R5$hi[1])}]"), R5_dec,
  "R6", "secondary", "§8.11: vignette check, then R6a gap_v2 95% CI vs 0.40", glue("vignette check passed: {vchk_ok}; gap_v2 = {f2(g95$diff)} [{f2(g95$lo)}, {f2(g95$hi)}], dz = {f2(g95$dz)}; R6b exploratory"), R6a,
  "U1a", "secondary", "§8.3: r(PHQ-4, disclosure) > 0, Holm with U2", if (U1a_testable) glue("r = {f3(ct$estimate)}, Holm p = {fp(p_holm2[['U1a']])}") else "code fails §7.4", U1a_dec,
  "U1b", "estimate", "§8.3: PHQ-4 coefficient on PSR, BF10, indirect effect", glue("b = {f3(hU$b)} [{f3(hU$lo)}, {f3(hU$hi)}], std. beta = {f3(hUz$b)}, BF10 = {fbf(bfU1b)}"), "estimate (no decision)",

  "O1", "secondary", "§8.13: Welch TOST ±0.39 on order", glue("diff = {f3(o_tost$diff)}, TOST p = {fp(o_tost$p_max)}; A:O p = {fp(hAO$p)}"), O1_dec)
ALLOWED <- list(primary = c("supported", "contradicted", "not supported", "inconclusive"),
                check = c("passes", "fails"),
                secondary = c("supported", "contradicted", "inconclusive", "not supported", "not testable", "passes", "fails", "accumulation", "narrowing",
                              "first impression", "first impression, with small growth", "first impression, with small narrowing",
                              "not interpretable: scale bound", "company-primary", "Sylva comparable to the company", "not interpretable"))
lab_ok <- with(PRED, ifelse(status %in% names(ALLOWED), map2_lgl(status, decision, ~ .y %in% ALLOWED[[.x]]), TRUE))
stopifnot(all(lab_ok), !anyNA(PRED$decision), all(c("H1", "R2a", "R2b", "H2", "H3", "MC-A", "MC-E", "M1", "M2", "H4", "H5", "D1", "D2", "S1",
                                                   "R1", "R2c", "R2d", "R3", "R4", "R5", "R6", "U1a", "U1b", "U2", "O1") %in% PRED$id))
```

```{r account-summary}

                  "narrowing" = "the gap shrank significantly: the static first-impression account is incomplete in the other direction",
                  "first impression" = , "first impression, with small growth" = , "first impression, with small narrowing" =
                    if (dWA$b >= DW_SCRIPT) "flat gap and free-chat tone at least as differentiated as the opening: first-impression account supported" else
                      "flat gap, but free chat less differentiated than the scripted opening: does not distinguish the two accounts",

save_tab(SCORE, "account_scorecard")
```

# 11. Robustness checks (§9.1)

```{r robustness}
tick("robustness")
# Decision under each check (§9.1): H1 supported if b(A) > 0 and p < .05; H2 the step-1 description; R2a/R2b by the raw-bound Welch TOST in
# case-removal checks (3-8, 11, 12, 13b) and 'robust' if the HC3 90% CI lies within ±0.40 in model checks (2, 9, 10, 13a).
prim <- function(d, extra = NULL, drop_AE = FALSE, label, kind = "sample") {
  terms <- c("A", "E", if (!drop_AE) "A:E", extra, vers_cov(d))
  fP <- lm(reformulate(terms, "psr_total"), data = d); fC <- lm(reformulate(terms, "liab_corp"), data = d)
  hA <- hc3(fP, "A"); hE <- hc3(fP, "E"); tE <- tost_f(d, "psr_total", "E", BOUND_PSR, "raw")
  r2 <- map_dfr(c("A", "E"), function(f) { h90 <- hc3(fC, f, .90); tr <- tost_f(d, "liab_corp", f, BOUND_R2, "raw")
    tibble(hyp = ifelse(f == "A", "R2a", "R2b"), b = h90$b, lo = h90$lo, hi = h90$hi, ci = "90% HC3", p = tr$p_max,
           decision = if (kind == "sample") dec_R2(tr$p_max, tr$p_t) else ifelse(h90$lo > -BOUND_R2 & h90$hi < BOUND_R2, "robust", "not robust")) })
  bind_rows(tibble(hyp = "H1", b = hA$b, lo = hA$lo, hi = hA$hi, ci = "95% HC3", p = hA$p, decision = dec_H1(hA$b, hA$p)),
            tibble(hyp = "H2", b = hE$b, lo = hE$lo, hi = hE$hi, ci = "95% HC3", p = hE$p, decision = desc_H2(hE$b, hE$p, tE$equivalent)), r2) %>%
    mutate(check = label, n = nrow(d))
}
hq <- function(d) { fw <- paste0("tipi_self_", c(1, 3, 5, 7, 9)); rv <- paste0("tipi_self_", c(2, 4, 6, 8, 10))
  M <- cbind(as.matrix(d[, fw]), 8 - as.matrix(d[, rv])); wsd <- apply(M, 1, sd); mh <- mahalanobis(M, colMeans(M), cov(M))
  d[wsd >= .5 & mh <= qchisq(.999, 10), ] }
# check 9: balance on each factor (Welch t); adjusted model adds imbalanced covariates and cb_slot (linear)
bal_vars <- c("d_age_clean", "phq4_total", "gaais_pos", "gaais_neg", "tipi_self_agree", "tipi_self_extra")
bal <- map_dfr(bal_vars, function(v) map_dfr(c("A", "E"), function(f) { t <- t.test(D[[v]][D[[f]] > 0], D[[v]][D[[f]] < 0]); tibble(var = v, factor = f, diff = unname(diff(rev(t$estimate))), p = t$p.value) }))
imb <- unique(bal$var[bal$p < .05])
n_cbslot_na <- sum(is.na(D$cb_slot))
D9 <- D %>% filter(if_all(all_of(c(imb, "cb_slot")), ~ !is.na(.x)))
# check 1: Welch t and Mann-Whitney U on the marginal groups
ck1 <- map_dfr(list(c("H1", "psr_total", "A"), c("H2", "psr_total", "E"), c("R2a", "liab_corp", "A"), c("R2b", "liab_corp", "E")), function(z) {
  x1 <- D[[z[2]]][D[[z[3]]] > 0]; x0 <- D[[z[2]]][D[[z[3]]] < 0]; tt <- t.test(x1, x0); w <- wilcox.test(x1, x0, exact = FALSE)
  tibble(hyp = z[1], b = mean(x1) - mean(x0), lo = tt$conf.int[1], hi = tt$conf.int[2], ci = "95% Welch", p = tt$p.value, p_mw = w$p.value,
         decision = "reported (Welch t and Mann-Whitney U p-values)", check = "1. Welch t / Mann-Whitney U", n = nrow(D)) })
ck8 <- D %>% filter(!any_finish_not_stop, system_prompt_sha256_match %in% TRUE, script_sha256_match %in% TRUE)
n_missing_only <- sum(D$n_finish_missing > 0 & D$n_finish_not_stop == D$n_finish_missing & D$system_prompt_sha256_match %in% TRUE & D$script_sha256_match %in% TRUE)
ROB <- bind_rows(
  ck1,
  prim(D, drop_AE = TRUE, label = "2. no A:E term", kind = "model"),
  prim(FULL, label = "3. full sample"),
  prim(D %>% filter(chat_send_attempts >= 12), label = "4. high engagement (chat_send_attempts >= 12)"),
  prim(D %>% filter(chat_total_rounds >= 12), label = "4 (also reported). chat_total_rounds >= 12"),
  prim(hq(D), label = "5. high-quality responders"),
  prim(D %>% filter(chat_api_error_count <= 2), label = "6. <= 2 failed API turns"),
  prim(D %>% filter(cb_source != "fallback_random"), label = "7. no fallback assignment"),
  prim(ck8, label = "8. finish_reason stop and both hash-match fields TRUE"),
  prim(D9, extra = c(imb, "cb_slot"), label = glue("9. balance-adjusted (+{paste(c(imb, 'cb_slot'), collapse = ', ')})"), kind = "model"),
  prim(D %>% filter(!is.na(bot_tokens_per_turn)), extra = "bot_tokens_per_turn", label = "10. verbosity-adjusted (sensitivity only)", kind = "model"),
  prim(D %>% filter(!(hyp_guess_keyword | hyp_guess_llm)), label = "11. hypothesis guessers excluded"),
  prim(D %>% filter(!first_msg_question), label = "12a. first message not a question"),
  prim(D %>% filter(!reply_ignores_direct_question), label = "12b. round-1 fit code reply_ignores_direct_question excluded"),
  prim(D, extra = "O", label = "13a. order as covariate", kind = "model"),
  prim(D %>% filter(order == "impression_first"), label = "13b. impression-first only"))
main <- prim(D, label = "registered")
ROB <- ROB %>% left_join(main %>% select(hyp, b_registered = b), by = "hyp") %>%
  mutate(pct_change = ifelse(grepl("^9\\.", check), 100 * (b - b_registered) / b_registered, NA_real_),       # check 9 only
         attenuation_gt25 = ifelse(grepl("^9\\.", check), (abs(b_registered) - abs(b)) / abs(b_registered) > .25, NA),
         decision = ifelse(grepl("^9\\.", check) & hyp == "H1", ifelse(decision == "supported", "robust to balance concerns", "not robust to balance concerns"), decision))
kt(ROB %>% select(check, hyp, n, b, lo, hi, ci, p, p_mw, decision, pct_change, attenuation_gt25), "Robustness checks for H1, H2, R2a, R2b (§9.1)")
kt(bal, glue("Check 9 balance tests; imbalanced: {ifelse(length(imb) == 0, 'none', paste(imb, collapse = ', '))}; {n_cbslot_na} participants without cb_slot omitted from the adjusted model only"))
catg("Check 8: {nrow(D) - nrow(ck8)} sessions excluded; {n_missing_only} of them only because a finish_reason was missing.")
D1_14 <- d1_decide(D %>% filter(ios_t2_status != "not_triggered"))
kt(tibble(check = "14. D1 without participants whose probe 2 was not triggered", n = D1_14$n, b = D1_14$b, p = D1_14$p, tost_p = D1_14$tost_p,
          scale_bound = D1_14$scale_bound, decision = D1_14$decision), "Check 14: the §8.8 D1 decision in the reduced sample")
rob3 <- ROB %>% filter(grepl("^3\\.", check))
directional <- function(hyp, dec) (hyp == "H1" & dec %in% c("supported", "contradicted")) |
  (hyp == "H2" & grepl("^(positive|negative) effect detected", dec))
robust_flag <- tibble(hyp = main$hyp, registered = main$decision, full_sample = rob3$decision, same_direction = sign(main$b) == sign(rob3$b)) %>%
  mutate(direction_applies = directional(hyp, registered),
         robust = registered == full_sample & (!direction_applies | same_direction))
kt(robust_flag, "A primary conclusion is robust if its direction and decision hold in the full sample (check 3); direction only for directional conclusions (log B06)")
amb("B06", "§9.1 (last paragraph)", "'A primary conclusion is described as robust if its direction and decision hold in the full-sample analysis (check 3)': R2a/R2b (equivalence), a non-supported H1 and the H2 descriptions 'effects as large as the smallest effect of interest excluded' and 'not resolved at this N' have no direction, and the sign of a near-zero estimate can flip between samples while the decision holds.",
    "Direction is required only for directional conclusions (H1 supported or contradicted; H2 positive or negative effect detected); otherwise the decision alone. The signs are shown.", "yes (the 'robust' label)")
save_tab(bind_rows(ROB, tibble(check = "14. D1 (probe 2 triggered only)", hyp = "D1", n = D1_14$n, b = D1_14$b, p = D1_14$p, decision = D1_14$decision)), "robustness")
```

# 14. Mock only: recovery of the planted effects

```{r recovery, eval = params$data_mode == "mock"}
tick("recovery")
T <- TRUTH
# Revision-3 estimands, from the same 200,000-person draw (seed 4242) of the generator as population_truth()
truth_rev3 <- function(eff, donors, n = 200000, seed = 4242) {
  old <- get(".Random.seed", envir = globalenv()); on.exit(assign(".Random.seed", old, envir = globalenv()))
  set.seed(seed)
  A <- sample(c(-.5, .5), n, TRUE); E <- sample(c(-.5, .5), n, TRUE); O <- sample(c(-.5, .5), n, TRUE)
  p <- gen_persons(A, E, O, eff, donors)
  tr <- function(i, j) (p[[paste0("tipi_bot_", i)]] + (8 - p[[paste0("tipi_bot_", j)]])) / 2
  X <- cbind(1, p$A, p$E, p$A * p$E); cf <- function(y, extra = NULL) qr.coef(qr(cbind(X, extra)), y)
  psr <- rowMeans(p[, paste0("psr_", 1:12)]); ec <- rowMeans(p[, paste0("ec_", 1:5)]); trs <- rowMeans(p[, paste0("tr_", 1:4)])
  ghalo <- (tr(3, 8) + ((8 - p$tipi_bot_4) + p$tipi_bot_9) / 2 + tr(5, 10)) / 3
  ghaloE <- (p$tipi_bot_3 + (8 - p$tipi_bot_8) + (8 - p$tipi_bot_4) + (8 - p$tipi_bot_10)) / 4
  ma_cap <- rowMeans(p[, paste0("ma_", c(1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 7))]); mp <- rowMeans(p[, paste0("mp_", 1:8)])
  bE <- cf(psr)[3]; textra <- tr(1, 6)
  Bc <- zs((zs(psr) + zs(ec) + zs(trs)) / 3)
  c(ratio_GE = unname(cf(ghaloE)[3] / cf(textra)[3]), ratio_G = unname(cf(ghalo)[3] / cf(textra)[3]),
    cprime_G = unname(cf(psr, ghalo)[3]), cprime_W = unname(cf(psr, p$W_true)[3]),
    R3_beta = unname(cf(zs(p$liab_6), zs(ma_cap))[5]),
    R4_beta_B = unname(cf(zs(p$liab_6), cbind(zs(ma_cap), zs(mp), Bc))[7]))
}
T3 <- truth_rev3(EFF, sim$donors)
H2b <- function(q) H2_boot %>% filter(quantity == q)
H4b <- function(s) H4A %>% filter(stat == s)
rec <- tribble(~estimand, ~truth, ~estimate, ~lo, ~hi,
  "H1 g (A on PSR, marginal)", T[["g_A_psr"]], g1$g, g1$g_lo, g1$g_hi,
  "H1 b(A) on PSR", T[["b_A_psr"]], h1$b, h1$lo, h1$hi,
  "H2 g (E on PSR, marginal)", T[["g_E_psr"]], g2$g, g2$g_lo, g2$g_hi,
  "H2 b(E) on PSR", T[["b_E_psr"]], h2$b, h2$lo, h2$hi,
  "R2a b(A) on Corp (90% CI)", T[["b_A_corp"]], R2$b[1], R2$ci90_lo[1], R2$ci90_hi[1],
  "R2b b(E) on Corp (90% CI)", T[["b_E_corp"]], R2$b[2], R2$ci90_lo[2], R2$ci90_hi[2],
  "M1 dW_A", T[["dW_A"]], dWA$b, dWA$lo, dWA$hi,
  "M1 dW_E (H2 step 2)", T[["dW_E"]], dWE$b, dWE$lo, dWE$hi,
  "H2 dG_E (G_halo)", T[["dG_E"]], dGE$b, dGE$lo, dGE$hi,
  "H2 b_W (within-cell)", T[["b_W"]], H2b("b_W")$estimate, H2b("b_W")$lo, H2b("b_W")$hi,
  "H2 b_G (within-cell)", T[["b_G"]], H2b("b_G")$estimate, H2b("b_G")$lo, H2b("b_G")$hi,
  "H2 P_G", T[["P_G"]], H2b("P_G")$estimate, H2b("P_G")$lo, H2b("P_G")$hi,
  "H2 c'_G (impression falsifier)", T3[["cprime_G"]], H2b("cprime_G")$estimate, H2b("cprime_G")$lo, H2b("cprime_G")$hi,
  "H2 D = |c'_G| - |c'_W| (step 4)", T[["D"]], H2b("D")$estimate, H2b("D")$lo, H2b("D")$hi,
  "MC-E b(E) on TIPI-E", T[["b_E_tipiE"]], mc_primary$b[2], mc_primary$lo[2], mc_primary$hi[2],
  "MC-A b(A) on TIPI-A", T[["b_A_tipiA"]], mc_primary$b[1], mc_primary$lo[1], mc_primary$hi[1],
  "H4 S_G", T[["S_G"]], H4b("S_G_halo")$estimate, H4b("S_G_halo")$lo, H4b("S_G_halo")$hi,
  "H4 S_MA", T[["S_MA"]], H4b("S_MA")$estimate, H4b("S_MA")$lo, H4b("S_MA")$hi,
  "D2 A effect on ios_t1 (SD_t1 units)", T[["ios_t1_A_d"]], d2$b / SD_t1, d2$lo / SD_t1, d2$hi / SD_t1,
  "D1 delta (growth)", T[["ios_change_A_delta"]], D1$delta, D1$lo / D1$SD_t1, D1$hi / D1$SD_t1,
  "R3 beta (ma_cap -> liab_6)", T3[["R3_beta"]], R3$beta[1], R3$lo95[1], R3$hi95[1],
  "R4 beta_B (bonding composite)", T3[["R4_beta_B"]], beta_B, hB$lo, hB$hi,
  "R6 gap_v2", T[["gap_v2"]], g95$diff, g95$lo, g95$hi,
  "R1 gap_v1 (company - Sylva)", T[["gap_v1"]], cs_pool$diff, cs_pool$lo, cs_pool$hi,
  "R5 r(company, Sylva)", T[["r_corp_chat"]], R5$r[1], R5$lo[1], R5$hi[1])
if (!is.null(H5)) {
  hq5 <- function(q) H5 %>% filter(quantity == q)
  rec <- bind_rows(rec, tibble(estimand = c("H5 ratio_GE (decision)", "H5 ratio_G", paste("H5 ratio", c("A", "C", "ES", "O"))),
                               truth = c(T3[["ratio_GE"]], T3[["ratio_G"]], unname(T[c("ratio_A", "ratio_C", "ratio_ES", "ratio_O")])),
                               estimate = map_dbl(c("ratio_GE", "ratio_G", "ratio_A", "ratio_C", "ratio_ES", "ratio_O"), ~ hq5(.x)$estimate),
                               lo = map_dbl(c("ratio_GE", "ratio_G", "ratio_A", "ratio_C", "ratio_ES", "ratio_O"), ~ hq5(.x)$lo),
                               hi = map_dbl(c("ratio_GE", "ratio_G", "ratio_A", "ratio_C", "ratio_ES", "ratio_O"), ~ hq5(.x)$hi)))
}
rec <- rec %>% mutate(covered = truth >= lo & truth <= hi)
kt(rec, glue("Recovery: population truth (200,000-person draw of the generator) vs estimate with its registered CI ({params$effects} effects)"))
save_tab(rec, "recovery")
```
